### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/7185802-allow-your-practitioners-to-rent-a-room-for-their-consultations

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The idea is to set up private appointments that the member can book, as well as payroll rules that will enable you to track what your practitioners owe you for any room rental. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Contrary to their original use, the payroll rules will allow you to know exactly how many hours the practitioner has used your room. With this information, you can invoice them for the hours they owe you.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading4 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h4 id="h_74c71d092a"><b>All you need to do is follow three simple steps:</b></h4></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Create private appointments and set-up the availabilities of practitioners (created in teacher&#x27;s section) from their teacher account, in order to offer slots that can be booked by members.<br/>​<br/>​<b>&gt; To help you set up your private appointments, please refer <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3974549-create-an-appointment-type">to this article</a>! </b><br/>​<br/>​</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Set the payroll rules that will determine how much practitioners are billed for each of their consultations, for the rental of your room. <br/>​<br/>Here, the aim is to set a fixed rate for each consultation: if a member books a one-hour slot, the teacher will have to pay you the amount of his fixed &quot;remuneration&quot;. <br/>​<br/>​<b>Here&#x27;s an example: </b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Room rental costs the practitioner €50, so I set my payroll rule so that it &quot;pays&quot; (which, in reality, will be billed to the teacher) a fixed rate of €50 per consultation.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><br/>A member books a consultation: this blocks a slot. I find the consultation on the teacher&#x27;s pay slip. I now know that the practitioner owes me €50 for the room rental he used to carry out his consultation with the member.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/772742601/43b2e9caabcd346a3a12823b/Capture+d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran+2023-06-27+a%CC%80+17.46.42.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2b1d94c859c8316863739601bf34283b48b98fe6aad7852cfc89bc2ef30e82fd&amp;req=cyclEc18m4FeFb4f3HP0gOwb1d8gN2yfiawpqo%2BXmG%2BkBypygbzkZ%2B7UMEvp%0Aqgo%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/772742601/43b2e9caabcd346a3a12823b/Capture+d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran+2023-06-27+a%CC%80+17.46.42.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2b1d94c859c8316863739601bf34283b48b98fe6aad7852cfc89bc2ef30e82fd&amp;req=cyclEc18m4FeFb4f3HP0gOwb1d8gN2yfiawpqo%2BXmG%2BkBypygbzkZ%2B7UMEvp%0Aqgo%3D%0A" alt="" width="1920" height="571"/></a></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Don&#x27;t forget billing! Two options here:</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>a.</b> Give members the option of paying their appointment card later, and keep all appointments unpaid until the teacher collects the person and registers them on the platform as <b>&quot;Manual Payment&quot;</b>.  </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ You will also need to give your practitioners/staff access so that they can manually update the invoice for their consultations/sessions once the member has done his session. </p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-center"><p>OR<br/>​<br/>b. Set the appointment card to 0€, so that all your members can book easily and can only pay the practitioner when they arrive at the consultation.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ The practitioner will not have to manually enter the payment in the back-office. The downside is that there will be no real accounting follow-up, as appointment cards will be invoiced at 0€.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-center"><h2 id="h_2f03f10545">For further information on how to manage your private appointments, go to the<a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/collections/3868472-appointments"> Appointment</a>s section of the Help Center.</h2></div><section ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3284721-the-class-hours-are-shifted-on-my-mobile-application-or-on-the-website

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To get the actual times of the courses, you just have to configure your computer tool so that it is in the right time zone.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Case:</b> Windows. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Clock in the taskbar.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Internet Time tab.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Check the box Automatically synchronize with an Internet time server.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Select a server in the list: France.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click on the &quot;Update&quot; button.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>2nd Case: </b>Mac. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Apple menu.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>System Preference.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Date and time.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Time Zone: Make sure the setting &quot;Set Time Zone Automatically Based on Current Location&quot; is active.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>3rd Case:</b> Apple. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Settings.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>General.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Date and time. This option automatically sets the date and time according to your time zone.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>4th Case:</b> Android.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Settings.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Date and time.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Check Automatic date and time.</p></div></li></ul></div>

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Step:</b> Login to the platform. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click on the following link: <a href="https://backoffice.bsport.io/login" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://backoffice.bsport.io/login</a> and log in with your login details. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you already have an account but do not know your password : </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click on &quot;Forgotten password&quot; &gt; Enter your email address. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/14210031-how-to-configure-passes-in-bsport-for-frequent-use-cases

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Managing passes effectively in bsport is crucial for ensuring smooth operations and a seamless client experience. This article addresses frequently asked questions related to pass credits, compatibility, and booking, along with actionable steps to resolve them.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_a1202be0f6">Pass Credits Usage and Compatibility</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_e21aff1515">Why did a client’s purchased credits not appear when they try to book a class?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If a client’s purchased credits do not appear, consider the following steps:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Check for multiple accounts</b>: <br/>Verify whether the client has multiple accounts. The purchase and credits might be linked to a different account. Consolidating the correct client account can resolve this issue. It is possible that the client has two separate email addresses registered with the studio. The pass may be assigned to one but not the other.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Check the validity of the pass: </b><br/>If the pass is not appearing it could be expired. You can check the validity of a pass on the members account by searching the members </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226379150/17b694bdf4195112e3fd921298a2/Screenshot+2026-04-01+at+15_32_57.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=c439a4cb2e8a87d79a2b1e80dcfa1df47434ae82bfdb1b99d0a522769b3d11e1&amp;req=diIlEMp5lIBaWfMW1HO4zbj8bpydajjrXo8zGkjMhRiU%2FaG8%2BzsmUtXgXSSW%0A7XIb%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226379150/17b694bdf4195112e3fd921298a2/Screenshot+2026-04-01+at+15_32_57.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=c439a4cb2e8a87d79a2b1e80dcfa1df47434ae82bfdb1b99d0a522769b3d11e1&amp;req=diIlEMp5lIBaWfMW1HO4zbj8bpydajjrXo8zGkjMhRiU%2FaG8%2BzsmUtXgXSSW%0A7XIb%0A" alt="" width="840" height="320"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Check the compatibility of the pass:</b><br/>You can do this through Classes &gt; Group Activities &gt; Select the activity. You will then see the section for &quot;Compatible Passes&quot; at the top. All the passes that are compatible with this activity will appear here.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226500438/eb63118f981c38ad91aceccb9e8d/Screenshot+2026-04-01+at+16_04_59.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3fbdcce17aa0e3fb97849829ac12ca0565969b0106dd7585cbe9934de684dc52&amp;req=diIlEMx%2BnYVcUfMW1HO4zdCwhehpy2kAeaqdT%2FjSxUBeudW8z%2FuQQiHlqVXz%0AFJwP%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226500438/eb63118f981c38ad91aceccb9e8d/Screenshot+2026-04-01+at+16_04_59.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3fbdcce17aa0e3fb97849829ac12ca0565969b0106dd7585cbe9934de684dc52&amp;req=diIlEMx%2BnYVcUfMW1HO4zdCwhehpy2kAeaqdT%2FjSxUBeudW8z%2FuQQiHlqVXz%0AFJwP%0A" alt="" width="828" height="393"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><br/>If the pass is not appearing, go to the Passes section &gt; Edit the pass by clicking the pencil &gt; Scroll down and you will see the following:<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226515003/5f6da4c2ec107b86401910f5d62b/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=9464bad7986f1b47394f597df6a25da921dd3eb368c988f0fe94ad423ddcf7ce&amp;req=diIlEMx%2FmIFfWvMW1HO4zbFdNIoJW8uVz8ZdS4hLRFNJr9mm53TxTuE9XQsx%0A1dUp%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2226515003/5f6da4c2ec107b86401910f5d62b/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=9464bad7986f1b47394f597df6a25da921dd3eb368c988f0fe94ad423ddcf7ce&amp;req=diIlEMx%2FmIFfWvMW1HO4zbFdNIoJW8uVz8ZdS4hLRFNJr9mm53TxTuE9XQsx%0A1dUp%0A" alt="" width="746" height="224"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><br/>You can restrict a pass by <b>Activity</b>, <b>Category</b>, and/or <b>Establishment</b>. It’s important to understand that these filters work with an <b>“AND” logic</b>, not “OR”.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For example, if a class has the category <i>Hatha Yoga</i> and the activity is <i>“Yoga with Lydia”</i>, selecting the activity <i>“Yoga with Lydia”</i> and the category <i>“Yoga”</i> will make the class <b>incompatible</b> with the pass. This is because the category must match exactly. <i>Hatha Yoga</i> is not the same as <i>Yoga</i>.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>As a best practice, we recommend setting compatibility using <b>either Activity or Category</b>, rather than both, unless it clearly aligns with your business needs.</p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>By addressing these factors, you can prevent duplicate purchases and ensure credits appear on the correct profile.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_105b7fc10f">Viewing and Booking with Available Credits</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_5dcce31d80">Why does a client with a multi-class pass show no credits available when trying to book?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If a pass is configured to be valid from the first booking, you can check this by going to <b>Passes &gt; Edit</b> and clicking the pencil icon. Verify the pass’s validity settings. For example, if the pass is set to start from the first booking and the member has already scheduled their first booking for next week, the pass will be valid starting next week. In this case, the member cannot use the pass this week, since its validity begins with their initial booking, which is already scheduled.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_fc16f98f9b">Why did past bookings appear to consume valid passes after a membership pause ended?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When a membership pause is applied, bookings can still be created during the pause period. Once the membership resumes, the system allocates valid passes to those previously created bookings. This behaviour is expected and ensures that bookings made during the pause are accounted for once the membership is active again.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_fbc4c3fb2e">Conclusion</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>By understanding and configuring passes effectively, you can resolve common issues related to credit discrepancies, compatibility, and booking. Example:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-code"><pre>&lt;button id=&quot;bsport-passes-widget&quot;&gt;</pre></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_111dbef87b"><br/>Step 2. Connect your button to the widget</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to <code>Settings &gt; Widgets</code> and copy paste the widget code on your website.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_af1fa98822">Widget type:</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Each widget type will connect differently:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Login button widget:</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add this code after the widget code and just before the <code>&lt;/script&gt;</code> tag :</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-code"><pre>document.addEventListener(&quot;DOMContentLoaded&quot;, function () {<br/>	var button = document.getElementById(&quot;button-id&quot;); <br/>	button.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;, function () {<br/>		const message = { type: &#x27;bsport:login-button:request-login&#x27;, data: {<br/>			&quot;uniqueWidgetId&quot;: &quot;unique-widget-id&quot; }<br/>		}<br/>		window.postMessage(message, &#x27;*&#x27;)<br/>   });<br/>});</pre></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>🚨 <b>Important</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Replace the <code>button-id</code> for the button id that you created</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Replace the <code>unique-widget-id</code> for the unique widget id inside the <b>MountBsportWidget</b> function and in the code snippet</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The bsport div should be hidden like this: &lt;div id=&quot;bsport-widget-id&quot; <code>style=&quot;display:none&quot;</code>&gt;&lt;/div&gt; </p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>It should look like this:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-code"><pre> &lt;script id=&quot;insert-bsport-widget-cdn&quot;&gt;<br/>      !(function (b, s, p, o, r, t) {<br/>        !typeof window.BsportWidget !== &quot;undefined&quot; &amp;&amp;<br/>          !document.getElementById(&quot;bsport-widget-cdn&quot;) &amp;&amp;<br/>          !(function () {<br/>            (m = b.createElement(s)),<br/>              (m.id = &quot;bsport-widget-cdn&quot;),<br/>              (m.src = p),<br/>              b.getElementsByTagName(&quot;head&quot;)[0].appendChild(m);<br/>          })();<br/>      })(document, &quot;script&quot;, &quot;https://cdn.bsport.io/scripts/widget.js&quot;);<br/>    &lt;/script&gt;<br/>    &lt;script id=&quot;bsport-widget-mount&quot;&gt;<br/>      function MountBsportWidget(config, repeat = 1) {<br/>        if (repeat &gt; 50) {<br/>          return;<br/>        }<br/>        if (!window.BsportWidget) {<br/>          return setTimeout(() =&gt; {<br/>            MountBsportWidget(config, repeat + 1);<br/>          }, 100 * repeat || 1);<br/>        }<br/>        BsportWidget.mount(config);<br/>      }<br/>    &lt;/script&gt;<br/>    &lt;script&gt;<br/>      MountBsportWidget({<br/>        parentElement: &quot;bsport-widget-id&quot;,<br/>        uniqueWidgetId: &quot;unique-widget-id&quot;,<br/>        companyId: &quot;company-id&quot;,<br/>        franchiseId: null,<br/>        dialogMode: 1,<br/>        widgetType: &quot;loginButton&quot;,<br/>        showFab: false,<br/>        fullScreenPopup: false,<br/>        styles: undefined,<br/>        config: {<br/>         loginButton: {}<br/>        },<br/>      });<br/>      /* Here the connection with the button and the function triggered when clicked */<br/>      document.addEventListener(&quot;DOMContentLoaded&quot;, function () {<br/>        var button = document.getElementById(&quot;button-id&quot;); <br/>        button.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;, function () {<br/>         	const message = {<br/>	         	type: &#x27;bsport:login-button:request-login&#x27;,<br/>	         	data: { &quot;uniqueWidgetId&quot;: &quot;your-unique-id&quot; } }<br/>        	window.postMessage(message, &#x27;*&#x27;)<br/>        });<br/>      });<br/>    &lt;/script&gt;<br/><br/>/* The result should be like this, it&#x27;s important to hide the div with the inline style or another login button will be displayed */<br/> &lt;div id=&quot;bsport-widget-id&quot; //ex. pass-3213<br/>	button.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;, function () {<br/>	var eventType = &quot;bsport:pass:add-to-cart:payment-pack&quot;;<br/>		var eventData = { payment_pack_id: &quot;payment_pack_id&quot;,<br/>		uniqueWidgetId: &quot;unique-widget-id&quot; ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/14432044-how-to-manage-unexpected-subscription-charges-and-billing-settings-in-bsport

<div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_a94e80ebc6">How to Manage Unexpected Subscription Charges and Billing Settings in bsport</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Managing subscription charges and billing settings effectively is crucial to avoid unexpected fees and ensure smooth operations. This article addresses common issues related to subscription charges, duplicate payments, and billing date adjustments in bsport, along with actionable solutions.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_09f469e036">Understanding Subscription Charges</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_bd189d869a">Why was I charged before my subscription started?</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In some cases, you may notice charges before your subscription officially begins. This typically happens when <b>transaction fees</b> from your clients’ online payments are included in an earlier invoice. For example, a February invoice might reflect only transaction fees (e.g., payment processing fees) and not the subscription itself. <br/>​<br/>In <b>Settings &gt; bsport subscription</b>, you can download the invoice of your payment to bsport under &quot;<b>My Invoices</b>&quot;. On this invoice you can see the breakdown of your subscription payment. This will include a field &quot;Payment Fees&quot;. These are your Stripe transaction fees for the previous month. You can further review the breakdown of these fees in <b>Reporting &gt; Payments</b> report to confirm the details.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_0acd95d082">Why am I still being charged if I thought my contract should have ended?</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For bsport subscriptions, the 12-month term starts from the date of the first successful payment, not from the signature date. Here’s how it works:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The contract is signed.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If a free trial period applies, billing starts after that period.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The first payment date sets the start of the 12-month term.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The term ends after 12 paid months, and the plan renews annually unless canceled in advance. </p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can further review this on your contract under the heading &quot;VALIDITY AND DURATION&quot;. To avoid unwanted renewals, ensure you submit a cancellation request several weeks before the term ends, <b>as specified in your agreement</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_daeb74d8a2">Managing Billing Dates and SEPA Transfers</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_8a791d8027">Why was a member charged before the 1st of the month via SEPA?</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This happens when the setting to send SEPA transfer orders in advance is enabled. With this option, SEPA payments are initiated a few days earlier to account for banking network delays, so members may see charges dated before the 1st even if the invoice shows the 1st. To ensure charges occur on the 1st of the month:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Navigate to <b>Settings &gt; Billing</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Disable the option to send SEPA transfer orders in advance.</p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2230231470/00822de0dea16a3d2eb1e3549fe3/Screenshot+2026-04-02+at+14_38_46.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3801d926da6172d684127804224ce0153cb08de651a4584f8323d3696568079e&amp;req=diIkFst9nIVYWfMW1HO4zY%2F1zvJqhbLb7FV0q62XF%2FBqL74HbDCyk59Z4ACu%0Asd1xkLhHhHqU5EOV02A%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2230231470/00822de0dea16a3d2eb1e3549fe3/Screenshot+2026-04-02+at+14_38_46.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3801d926da6172d684127804224ce0153cb08de651a4584f8323d3696568079e&amp;req=diIkFst9nIVYWfMW1HO4zY%2F1zvJqhbLb7FV0q62XF%2FBqL74HbDCyk59Z4ACu%0Asd1xkLhHhHqU5EOV02A%3D%0A" alt="" width="1377" height="582"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Note: Disabling this option ensures SEPA payments are initiated on the billing date (e.g., the 1st), but enabling it can help account for banking delays.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_8a719bb1e7">General Tips for Subscription Management</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Regularly review your subscription settings and billing reports to identify any discrepancies early.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Communicate billing policies clearly to your clients to avoid confusion.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Submit cancellation requests well in advance to prevent unwanted renewals.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>By following these guidelines, you can effectively manage subscription charges and billing settings in bsport, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your clients.</p></div><section class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 related_articles my-6"><hr class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 my-6 sm:my-8"/><div class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 mb-3 text-xl font-bold">Related ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3302803-my-mobile-application-doesn-t-recognize-my-geolocation

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To activate your geolocation, here is the procedure:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Case:</b> I have an Android. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Open the settings menu of your phone.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the personal section, click on Location.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then press Mode.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>2nd Case: </b>I have an iPhone. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to Settings &gt; Privacy &gt; Location service.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Check that the Location Service feature is enabled.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Scroll down to find the desired app. Touch the app and select an option.</p></div></li></ul></div><section class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 related_articles my-6"><hr class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 my-6 sm:my-8"/><div class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 mb-3 text-xl font-bold">Related Articles</div><section class="flex flex-col rounded-card border border-solid border-card-border bg-card-bg p-2 sm:p-3"><a class="duration-250 group/article flex flex-row justify-between gap-2 py-2 no-underline transition ease-linear hover:bg-primary-alpha-10 hover:text-primary sm:rounded-card-inner sm:py-3 rounded-card-inner px-3" href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3284721-the-class-hours-are-shifted-on-my-mobile-application-or-on-the-website" data-testid="article-link"><div class="flex flex-col p-0"><span class="m-0 text-md text-body-primary-color group-hover/article:text-primary">The class hours are shifted on my mobile application or on the website.</span></div><div class="flex shrink-0 flex-col justify-center p-0"><svg class="block h-4 w-4 text-primary ltr:-rotate-90 rtl:rotate-90" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M5.293 7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 10.586l3.293-3.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></a></section></section>

### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/5331994-manager-view-your-lessons-as-a-teacher-on-the-mobile-application

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 1:</b> Use the right access. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Even if you are a manager and you have access to the backoffice, to see your classes on the mobile application, you need to use your teacher access. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This access allows you to connect to the application as a teacher to view the list of classes and appointments for which you are the teacher. You can also check-in on the attendance.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The email address used to connect must be the one entered in the teacher account in &quot;My Studio&quot; &gt; &quot;Teachers&quot;, in the backoffice.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/730107644/c1267af6a4f0cc1dfbe0bab1/Screenshot+2023-04-27+at+19.09.28.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d31c3b0cfde8690b3362917fa7bedc2bf9439c3869c6612eb85fadb4c6f97ebd&amp;req=cyMnF8l5m4VbFb4f3HP0gB3FoE6%2BekMSnUg9jbzNm%2B6fFNWVLrsspalf2Gbh%0AjiW9FcN3QooX%2BO7B%2Fw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/730107644/c1267af6a4f0cc1dfbe0bab1/Screenshot+2023-04-27+at+19.09.28.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d31c3b0cfde8690b3362917fa7bedc2bf9439c3869c6612eb85fadb4c6f97ebd&amp;req=cyMnF8l5m4VbFb4f3HP0gB3FoE6%2BekMSnUg9jbzNm%2B6fFNWVLrsspalf2Gbh%0AjiW9FcN3QooX%2BO7B%2Fw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1920" height="697"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 2:</b> Check the teacher entered in your sessions. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In order for the lessons to be visible on the application, the teacher entered on the session must be the right one. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To see this, click on &quot;Calendar&quot; &gt; Choose the session to check.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/730108725/8022f11c34eca755e3d56c95/Screenshot+2023-04-27+at+19.10.53.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=cddd8a55aba800917a2edec68b7118bcf7c91522ccf7c6024b24eb504f311631&amp;req=cyMnF8l2moNaFb4f3HP0gAwwT0Ym0YDSfXxC1%2Buba%2Bg%2BuJECr5DJ7q3UZ2mq%0AVmmyHcvebdDtX3pvDw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/730108725/8022f11c34eca755e3d56c95/Screenshot+2023-04-27+at+19.10.53.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=cddd8a55aba800917a2edec68b7118bcf7c91522ccf7c6024b24eb504f311631&amp;req=cyMnF8l2moNaFb4f3HP0gAwwT0Ym0YDSfXxC1%2Buba%2Bg%2BuJECr5DJ7q3UZ2mq%0AVmmyHcvebdDtX3pvDw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1915" height="937"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The teacher&#x27;s name is displayed on the right.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading4 intercom-interblocks-align-center"><h4 id="h_0eff9367df">⚠️ If your teacher is archived, the lessons will not appear on the application. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6474912-display-the-order-of-the-sessions-in-the-calendar

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once you have created your group activities/workshops and added the sessions, they will appear in the calendar.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Sessions display in the calendar, for each day, <b>according to their starting time.</b> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>However, if <b>several sessions start at the same time</b>, the sessions scheduled at the same hour will display chronologically according to their <b>order of creation.  </b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This means the last added session will display at the bottom, and the first added session will display at the top.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Example :</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Here, 4 sessions are scheduled on the 17th at 12:00 PM.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/565816668/c161bacddc9a868b96f8d477/5.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=8cc5c18f489e02550cc9cbdbd1f6d9ab41734c4e2b159649d23ffc0d472b51ea&amp;req=cSYiHsh4m4dXFb4f3HP0gJ5u83YirTmw9hFJvvgbjHbF3HsLafbw3PWNe%2F7y%0A1Il7H3BcywvD%2FlfUMw%3D%3D%0A" <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>As part of the functionality to set up online courses using a videoconference platform,<b> we have set up an easy-to-use video conferencing system </b>(no application downloads and compatible with a large number of tools).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>However, being an outsourced service that we do not have control over, we will not be able to provide any support on this platform.</b><br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>There are 2 options you can use for this :</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st option:</b> Use our Zoom integration add-on to automatically manage online courses, create Zoom meetings and automatically populate the links in each session and send them to booked students.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Follow the steps described in this article: <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3901503-set-up-your-zoom-integration-for-you-online-sessions">https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3901503-set-up-your-zoom-integration-for-you-online-sessions</a>. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/7969371-create-a-hybrid-session

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can create hybrid classes that are both on-site and online. This option is available for both group activities and workshops.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 1: Create the sessions</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Complete the session creation form with the parameters you want for the on-site session.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Activate the toggle named &quot;Hybrid session&quot;.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754160980/0881ca1416a570923e3d9136/Screenshot+2023-06-01+at+11-50-59+Add+sessions.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6ecfaa3df1c9d333157742a32f6bbfc65b8d7f8e1b1d136b9495bee80000713f&amp;req=cyUjF89%2BlIlfFb4f3HP0gPajZRNZ9g8AYaKwO6zW6A5J2YtyomTrCRlsjDyR%0Aj1vgikpPfAUkDyS1Gw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754160980/0881ca1416a570923e3d9136/Screenshot+2023-06-01+at+11-50-59+Add+sessions.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6ecfaa3df1c9d333157742a32f6bbfc65b8d7f8e1b1d136b9495bee80000713f&amp;req=cyUjF89%2BlIlfFb4f3HP0gPajZRNZ9g8AYaKwO6zW6A5J2YtyomTrCRlsjDyR%0Aj1vgikpPfAUkDyS1Gw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="385" height="71"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This will create 2 sessions at once: one will be on-site, the other online.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> It also works when creating recurring sessions, creating duplicate sessions for all recurrences.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Note: </b>Hybrid sessions are only available for activities and workshops that have been indicated as not Livestream. Check on your activities and workshops that the &quot;Livestream&quot; checkbox is unchecked.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 2: Edit the online session</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The online session is automatically named “{Session Name} Online” and has by default 100 available spots.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can edit the number of available slots, the size of the waiting list, and the number of credits required for the online session.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>However, since the online session is linked to the on-site session, other settings such as time and date and teacher can only be modified by editing the on-site session.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 3: Manage your sessions</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Hybrid sessions are easily recognizable on the Backoffice Calendar thanks to their specific icon, as well as the helper text that appears when hovering over them.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754087910/4704b41f08d69939f36b58e4/Hybrid_session_BO_EN.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6f72f4e06b49edaa05e379bf35542993bbb40caecbc51ea7231ea6cc981a15e1&amp;req=cyUjFsF5lIBfFb4f3HP0gGdJSmE6xQkbRc4kcVmtIcMp5VstYT6VX4WrrYU6%0AhczO8mlMRow609SIxg%3D%3D%0A" **URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6149203-how-to-add-tags-to-your-sessions

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>By adding tags to your sessions you can make them invisible and not bookable for members who don&#x27;t have the right tags. This feature allows you for example to hide advanced sessions from novice members.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_4c1b4bad00"><b>Step 1 - Create tags</b></h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Create your tags from the &quot;Marketing&quot; tab &gt; &quot;Tags&quot;. Click <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/5546142-understanding-the-tag-management-screen">here</a> for instructions. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_409c03afff"><b>Step 2 - Add tags to sessions from the calendar</b></h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to the &quot;Calendar&quot; intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_fe00cab0bf">Managing overlaps and conflicts</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When a teacher, location or activity is already booked for another class or appointment:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The time slot will display a <b>striped pattern</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You will not be able to create a new availability or event at that time.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This logic applies to:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Individual appointments</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Group activities and workshops</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Recurring availabilities</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_886ae405d0">Multi-teacher and multi-establishment availabilities</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can create an availability for:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Multiple teachers</b> (when more than one person can lead a class)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Multiple establishments</b> (if the session can occur in any available establishment).</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>We only display availabilities that match all selected criteria, meaning that <b>each selected resource must be free</b> at the same time. If one teacher or establishment is unavailable, the slot will appear as unavailable.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_d1f6d238b6">Using filters</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The Schedule view includes several filters to help you focus on the information that matters most:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-table"><table><tbody><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Filter</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Purpose</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Establishment</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Display or hide establishment availability</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Teacher</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Display or hide teacher availability</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Activity</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Filters the view by activity type (Group activities &amp; workshop, Appointments, Tasks / personal appointments)</p></div></td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Use filters to quickly isolate a single teacher, establishment or activity type.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can also switch between <b>day</b>, <b>week</b>, or <b>month</b> views depending on how much detail you need.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The <b>Group by</b> option lets you organize the view by <b>Establishment</b>, <b>Teacher</b> or <b>Activity</b>. This allows you to view filtered teachers, establishments or activities side by side for easier comparison.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div ## Access-Control (9 articles)

### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620345-understanding-access-control

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Access Control refers to the different tools available on bsport that allow you to manage who can access your studio. The overall logic of Access Control is the same across all tools; however, there are two ways for your members to gain access:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_ba815d670e">Manual Entry</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Manual entry is designed for studios without automatic doors but with staff at the reception desk to welcome members. The staff can use a barcode scanner to retrieve member information and decide whether to grant access.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_031ff30575">Auto Entry</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Auto entry is designed for studios equipped with automatic doors and typically operating without staff at the reception. The process is fully automated: members simply click to open the door, and the system determines whether they are allowed to enter.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_d3cb2cf823">Let&#x27;s get started</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Let&#x27;s see how to set up Access Control based on the type of entry you&#x27;ve selected.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/9286023-how-to-activate-access-control-manual-entry">Activate manual entry</a></p></div></li><li><div ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/9286023-how-to-activate-access-control-manual-entry

<div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Before reading this article, make sure you&#x27;ve read this <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620345-understanding-access-control">one</a> first.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Manual entry allows you to check member access validity in real-time and ensure that only authorized members enter your studio. Most important member information is quickly displayed your studio’s receptionists to ensure a seamless flow, both for your members and your staff.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_49d8d3dda3">Scanner configuration</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_6493fd13ae">Step 1 - Order the scanner</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Before monitoring the visits to your studio, you will have to order the scanner(s) that will be used to scan members&#x27; barcodes on their app</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e8e8e880;border-color:#73737633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Note that the scanners are not included in the feature and their cost has to be covered by the studio</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Here are the scanner references that we recommend: <b><a href="https://www.amazon.co.uk/Honeywell-Genesis-7580g-Multi-IF-Silver/dp/B00LOUBCZC" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Honeywell Genesis 7580g</a></b> or <b><a href="https://www.newland-id.com/fr/produits/lecteur-de-codes-barres-fixe/fm3056-grouper" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Newland FM3056</a>. </b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>We recommend these scanners as we were able to test them and make sure the feature is working properly. However, they are not the only scanners on the market that are compatible.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you wish to use another reference, make sure to meet the following requirements :</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Be able to read barcodes on screens</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Be able to be plugged into the reception PC via a USB cable</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The configuration of the scanner must allow a high-speed reading mode (otherwise the scanning will not trigger a visit but only the display of a text)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The configuration of the scanner must be able to allow the display of the following format after reading a barcode: &quot;A+number&quot; (for example A629658220923)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e8e8e880;border-color:#73737633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Please note that should you go for another reference than the recommended one, we can not guarantee that the feature will work properly</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_67a25f1e3b">Step 2 - Configure the scanner</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Follow the steps of the following documentation to configure your chosen barcode reader: <a href="https://bright-shovel-41b.notion.site/Honeywell-barcode-scanner-configuration-add3ba7f62fc4a08be98f9b81d25d0aa" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Honeywell barcode scanner configuration</a> or <a href="https://bright-shovel-41b.notion.site/Newland-barcode-scanner-configuration-c37fdd537a804652a7626e357568bb20" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Newland barcode scanner configuration</a> and check that it results in the display of the correct format</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_17a1b44e7a"></h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_c3acbb215a">Staff configuration</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once the feature is available on your back-office, go to the <i>Staff</i> page in <i>Settings</i></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_5a71734ee7">Step 1 - Create a receptionist role</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you do not have a role dedicated to the reception yet, click on &quot;Add role&quot; and name it. If you already have such a role, click on the Edit icon.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For the permissions, give at least the <b>permission to &quot;Perform access monitoring&quot;</b> in <i>Navigation menu &gt; Access Monitoring</i>. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>We also recommend permitting the &quot;<b>Access location visits history</b>&quot; to facilitate the receptionist tasks.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For the other permissions, please refer to our <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/9305840-staff-permissions-details">helpsheet on the permission details</a> and select what better corresponds to the actions that you want to allow your receptionists to do.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1051936870/be98e16d44e48339642d9e01/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=c2e725be09446ea4f6179608fe159947056931dddce3c05a856aa2527845e7b8&amp;req=dSAiF8B9m4lYWfMW1HO4zWmQ9YK%2BniTM1bDPXb%2BR7kam36XIeo%2F8Hn34qHDe%0APMOmLTR%2BDGXDMyOSBh0%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1051936870/be98e16d44e48339642d9e01/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=c2e725be09446ea4f6179608fe159947056931dddce3c05a856aa2527845e7b8&amp;req=dSAiF8B9m4lYWfMW1HO4zWmQ9YK%2BniTM1bDPXb%2BR7kam36XIeo%2F8Hn34qHDe%0APMOmLTR%2BDGXDMyOSBh0%3D%0A" alt="" style="width:500px"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_813eef29b1">Step 2 - Create a receptionist staff account</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Each receptionist staff account will be able to monitor visits from a fixed place where a scanner and reception desk will be posted. You can create as many receptionist staff accounts as you have areas to monitor entry for.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><br/>​<i>For example, you may wish to create a receptionist staff account for the general entry of one of your studios, another one for the entry of a specific sub-part of the studio, and another one for the general entry of another studio.</i></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To do so, click on &quot;Add staff&quot;, name it, and enter the generic email and password that will be used when logging in to the computer placed at the entrance of the area.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then select the &quot;receptionist&quot; role</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1051965877/0860eec170a7c86c3f1bd201/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3d21a0820193c2042dade79276c403794dcff4ccaac5918702ac8f61df62b2aa&amp;req=dSAiF8B4mIlYXvMW1HO4zSuOw8TGiFfe2KztNT9ip%2FCx%2BVr%2F7gPYOG1ohV9T%0Ax5xkfyJF5ZqGmBTUctM%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1051965877/0860eec170a7c86c3f1bd201/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3d21a0820193c2042dade79276c403794dcff4ccaac5918702ac8f61df62b2aa&amp;req=dSAiF8B4mIlYXvMW1HO4zSuOw8TGiFfe2KztNT9ip%2FCx%2BVr%2F7gPYOG1ohV9T%0Ax5xkfyJF5ZqGmBTUctM%3D%0A" alt="" style="width:500px"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the Teacher restriction section, if wanted, apply restrictions on some of the teachers (for more information see our helpsheet on <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6460296-how-to-restrict-the-permissions-granted-to-your-staff-accounts">How to restrict the permissions granted to your staff accounts.</a>)</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the Access Monitoring section, indicate here the area for which this access will monitor visits.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the desk is at the general entrance of the studio, select the location/address of the studio and leave the establishment field empty (if empty, all establishments are considered selected by default)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the desk is at the entrance of a specific area of the studio, select the location/address of the studio and the ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11906806-how-to-activate-access-control-auto-entry

<div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Before reading this article, make sure you&#x27;ve read this <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620345-understanding-access-control">one</a> first </p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To allow auto entry, bsport is partnering with <a href="https://www.getkisi.com" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Kisi</a>. Before going further in this article, it is mandatory to get in contact with Kisi so you are fully onboarded and your Kisi account is set up with all your doors configured and correctly linked to hardware. Once this is done, you can go on with this article. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_6a0c40626e">Connect bsport to Kisi</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_8dcd2430b8">Create a group on Kisi</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>First you will need to create a Group in Kisi. We will use this group as the access rules for your members.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You&#x27;ll be able to define the doors to which your members will have access to (if you have multiple doors). But also during which time period of the day your members can have access to the doors. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In Kisi, go to <i>Groups </i>and then <i>Add Group</i></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1998408249/38a2e635b07840e134b217387480/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=843ba6b63e5ebd4d054665a40f63edf8c540f16fb6082fae370a710296b4384a&amp;req=dSkuHs1%2BlYNbUPMW1HO4zU8Q52Vgts7rCV7Ka%2BRwV5ZYCaYXzM15Oqj1NmG7%0ALvIPqpMt2FwrMgtalXw%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1998408249/38a2e635b07840e134b217387480/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=843ba6b63e5ebd4d054665a40f63edf8c540f16fb6082fae370a710296b4384a&amp;req=dSkuHs1%2BlYNbUPMW1HO4zU8Q52Vgts7rCV7Ka%2BRwV5ZYCaYXzM15Oqj1NmG7%0ALvIPqpMt2FwrMgtalXw%3D%0A" alt="" width="2940" height="1322"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Fill the name and description. We recommend indicating clearly in the name that this group is for the bsport users.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>We recommend NOT to toggle <i>Scope to a Place. </i>This allows for more flexibility in the future as this is a setting that cannot be changed once the group is created.</p></div></li><li><div id="h_fc06cc4462">If you are a franchise </h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you are a franchise or a brand using the bsport Master Account. And if you have multiple studios in your Master Account using Access Control auto entry, please repeat the previous steps for each of your franchisees/studios that need Access Control auto entry. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Create one group for each franchisees</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Indicate in the name which franchisee this group controls</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the groups make sure you select only the doors belonging to the given franchisee</p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Create one user for each franchisees and assign it the right group</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Generate an API Key for each users</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Make sure to indicate clearly to your Account Manager which API Key belongs to which franchisee</p></div></li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_4469026291">Choose your security method</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Auto entry is based on a click-to-open logic. Meaning that your members can open doors through their app by clicking on a button. Learn how this works by following this <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11928083-how-can-my-members-unlock-a-door">helpsheet.</a></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In order to prevent fraud, you want to make sure that your members are actually close to the door when opening it. To reduce this risk, we have different ways to protect your studio:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>geofencing</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>proximity proof</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Please select one of the following security protections and reach out to your account manager for them to activate it.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#feedaf80;border-color:#fbc91633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Whatever method is selected, members always have to be connected to the internet if they want to be able to open doors.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_d1f625b803">Geofencing </h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Geofencing defines a radius around your doors in which a member has to be in order to be able to unlock said doors. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To activate it, please contact your Account Manager and give them the radius (in meters) within which members should be in order to unlock doors.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>We recommend setting a radius of at least 500 meters around your entrance. This allows for normal variations in phone localization accuracy due to GPS and network conditions. </p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Wait for your Account Manager to confirm that everything is in place.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e8e8e880;border-color:#73737633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ If you have enabled geofencing on bsport, make sure the <b>&quot;Geofence restriction&quot;</b> toggle is <b>disabled</b> in your Kisi interface. bsport runs its own geofencing layer: having both active at the same time will prevent access from working entirely.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_09527752a5">Proximity proof</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Proximity proof uses Bluetooth to make sure that the member’s phone is next to a reader. If it’s the case, the member will be able to open the door. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If they are too far from the reader, the door won’t open. In this scenario, the members still have to click to open the door inside the app.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For proximity proof to work, you need to have a reader for each of your doors. You can order your readers <a href="https://kisiconnect.com" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">here</a>. We advise the Reader Pro 2.1 (High frequency). ⚠️ <b>Only Kisi reader is compatible with proximity proof. You cannot use another reader.</b></p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To activate it, please contact your Account Manager.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you chose this option, please follow the installation guide for proximity proof <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/13350916-how-to-activate-proximity-proof-for-auto-entry">here</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin
