### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620650-set-up-access-control

<div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This article applies to both auto entry and manual entry. You can check the definition <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620345-understanding-access-control">here</a>.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Now that Access Control is enabled on your studio, let&#x27;s see how to set up your passes and bookings to allow your members to enter.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_7e1878f7cb">Set up your passes and subscriptions</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_0773b4019d">Passes</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To allow your members to enter your studio, they will need to own a pass or subscription giving them access in order to do so:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the pass creation flow or edition flow, go to the &quot;Door Access&quot; section</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Activate the toggle &quot;Grant studio access&quot;</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1786968989/b978c63e230ec153c0abd041d0f0/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2aed747a7d70ab43826164322dd1c4c81699324418610c3013d6384de1d18066&amp;req=dScvEMB4lYhXUPMW1HO4zSdQ9r%2BT7KSoH97nnyrmJxkJaiTXApZ53dd0lM%2Bq%0ARbyrS57QaFrLhuv0ZwA%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1786968989/b978c63e230ec153c0abd041d0f0/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2aed747a7d70ab43826164322dd1c4c81699324418610c3013d6384de1d18066&amp;req=dScvEMB4lYhXUPMW1HO4zSdQ9r%2BT7KSoH97nnyrmJxkJaiTXApZ53dd0lM%2Bq%0ARbyrS57QaFrLhuv0ZwA%3D%0A" alt="" width="2200" height="552"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For auto entry only, once activated, this pass will allow all the members owning it to <b>open every door</b> in your studio. This will also apply to passes already owned by members before the toggle was activated.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The rights to access the studio will remain valid as long as the pass has not expired.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If this pass is used in a subscription, this subscription will also give access to the studio to the members subscribed. For a pass used in subscriptions, we advise you to indicate &quot;Valid from the billing date&quot; as the start date of the pass.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_5bc147746c">Valid from first use</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you granted studio access to the pass, you&#x27;ll see a new option in the start date options for your pass: <i>Valid from the first use</i>. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This option can be used for day passes for example. To learn how to set up this kind of pass, please follow this <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12621911-access-control-passes-activated-on-first-use">helpsheet</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_751d967f44">Off peak passes</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>On passes, you can restrict booking to certain times. But this option is also compatible with Access Control. This way you can indicate if the pass gives access to your studio on a specific day on specific hours. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787232010/41477e6d27737ee64e24a39ac218/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=dcbe13fc887c69ac20fe5b1b37d24cedc9ac86e573b7bfaf3a3ab0c875880276&amp;req=dScvEct9n4FeWfMW1HO4zaFsnH7iKRzHUsLRHAPjxPmedqY26HfFJZelUk6p%0AARN84sHrNK4j1Fedufo%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787232010/41477e6d27737ee64e24a39ac218/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=dcbe13fc887c69ac20fe5b1b37d24cedc9ac86e573b7bfaf3a3ab0c875880276&amp;req=dScvEct9n4FeWfMW1HO4zaFsnH7iKRzHUsLRHAPjxPmedqY26HfFJZelUk6p%0AARN84sHrNK4j1Fedufo%3D%0A" alt="" width="884" height="576"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_e9e1dc1c83">Establishment access</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For manual entry you can define if a pass gives access to certain establishments using the restrictions on establishments. ### Intercom

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The following logic applies for both manual entry and auto entry, please remember that:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Manual entry </b>allows you to check member access validity in real-time and ensure that only authorized members enter your studio. Most important member information is quickly displayed to your studio’s receptionists to ensure a seamless flow, both for your members and your staff.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Auto entry</b> allows your member to enter autonomously in your studio. This feature removes the necessity of manually controlling each entrance and enables your staff to focus on what is truly important.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Since everything happens under the hood, it is important for you to understand the logic of Access Control, to know when a member can enter and when they cannot. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Before reading this article, make sure you&#x27;ve set up everything correctly for Access Control to work.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/9286023-how-to-activate-access-control-manual-entry">Set up for manual entry</a></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11906806-how-to-activate-access-control-auto-entry">Set up for auto entry </a></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12620650-set-up-access-control">Common set up</a></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>See how your members can find there access credentials <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11928083-how-can-my-members-access-my-studio">here</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_96f07f7a33">The member can enter</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For a member to be able to enter the studio we will check the following:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_31d40edc72">1 - Localisation</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To make sure the member is at the right place, the system will check the localisation of the member. For manual entry and auto entry the method used is not the same:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_ceb3c30e66">Manual entry</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Localisation will be based on the establishment linked to the staff connected. Only members with passes or bookings compatible with the staff&#x27;s establishment will be able to enter.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_3982e679d7">Auto entry</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Localisation will be based on the geolocation of the member&#x27;s phone. Members will be able to enter only establishments with which their passes or bookings are compatible.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This only applies to passes and group classes. Not appointments or appointment passes.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_a0797da413">2 - Checking on the passes and subscriptions</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then we will check if the member owns at least one pass with <i>Grant studio access </i>activated.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If not, we&#x27;ll move on to part number 3.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If yes, we&#x27;ll move on to the other checks of this section.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then we&#x27;ll check if the pass is valid and active:</p></div><div validity period.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The pass shouldn&#x27;t be blocked.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_39207c4fd1">Warning status</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In this case the member as validated all the previous checks to enter, however there are some warnings to be aware of:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>the member has a session planned in an establishment not compatible with the zone that you are monitoring access for (manual entry only)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>the member uses a pass not compatible with the zone that you are monitoring access for (manual entry only)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>the member has a session in a compatible establishment but has an unpaid invoice or a negative account balance</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>the member has a session in a compatible establishment but does not have a pass</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>the member has recently changed their profile picture </p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The behavior is not going to be the same if it&#x27;s for manual entry or auto entry:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Manual entry:</b> An action is required on your part to regularize the member&#x27;s status and address the warnings before letting the member enter or not. </p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Auto entry:</b> The door will still open for the member. However, in the entry history you will see the warning status on the member.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_495a8bd5c3">Acknowledge and address warnings</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This part is only meant for manual entry</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>All warnings will appear below the member information and can be addressed from here.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787300072/d37be859c46262e47516a859f20d/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=51eecd6ffa06f17032923c1d9fc23ff41cdec41a97b47269186e2c4f61b2c255&amp;req=dScvEcp%2BnYFYW%2FMW1HO4zZhmAh%2BUCQNV2TS%2F9W6tgmLgU8%2BkTzu6wMjtiVaL%0AnJI1DfxoamfgRRd88Nc%3D%0A" intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The warning regarding a recent change in the profile picture is the only exception and is displayed next to the member picture </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787300055/96f0286e9edf092ddb3b4b0a552e/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=cafb375eff15dcc7ba57ae592aa6f140c91cd4bc6a01369caeae743bebe956fd&amp;req=dScvEcp%2BnYFaXPMW1HO4zVwlnofB%2BPSlGCybW3QRmVIK%2B2gCovoA%2FFif6UvZ%0ASa9OXCtV9UROi9%2FG59Y%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787300055/96f0286e9edf092ddb3b4b0a552e/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=cafb375eff15dcc7ba57ae592aa6f140c91cd4bc6a01369caeae743bebe956fd&amp;req=dScvEcp%2BnYFaXPMW1HO4zVwlnofB%2BPSlGCybW3QRmVIK%2B2gCovoA%2FFif6UvZ%0ASa9OXCtV9UROi9%2FG59Y%3D%0A" alt="" width="2400" height="1368"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To address this warning, please make sure that the member checking in is the same person as shown on the picture. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To do so, click on &quot;See previous&quot; and open the picture history. If you can confirm that the member matches their picture, click on &quot;Validate identity&quot;. The warning will then disappear. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once you have acknowledged all warnings and if you have addressed some or all of them, you can click on the button &quot;Refresh status&quot;. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If all warnings were addressed and the status of the member has changed, you will be notified in the member information </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787300058/147664e994d95a20b0356c7b60d5/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=7099a219406f71bbc1903f6c65ac9c81ca21422abbcf37636c553c563caac668&amp;req=dScvEcp%2BnYFaUfMW1HO4zTPENXMoH9v53shqIoqC2yBf8CMuY04SHbfFe5Ml%0ANjK%2F5Y%2BLPWG71A5p7vo%3D%0A" intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_d426cc51d0">Indicate if the member is allowed to enter or not</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the member has a warning status, you will have to indicate if the member is allowed to enter or not.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can decide to allow a member to enter even if not all warnings were addressed, depending on the type of warning and your studio&#x27;s policy.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To do so, either click on &quot;Refuse entry&quot; or &quot;Allow entry&quot;</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787300031/3e06551db9127f8ed5261f8dac33/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=49c701fd07d97201aff719c26c024e7589183e7eee99eb40f9e20bd989c760cf&amp;req=dScvEcp%2BnYFcWPMW1HO4zX%2BG3nEGtQDUrNeiE8%2BNzQETRviz6af3rIjvQIvV%0AibBC2p9GGH6lQ%2BpBizk%3D%0A" class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For auto entry, &quot;Allow entry&quot; will be selected automatically.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_41efaa4f16">Not valid status</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This status means that the member doesn&#x27;t have the right to enter. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Actions are required on your part and the member is not allowed to enter as long as warnings are not addressed. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>What is expected from you is not the same if it&#x27;s for manual entry or auto entry:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Manual entry:</b> Check on why the member cannot enter and try to solve the situation.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Auto entry:</b> The door will not open to the member.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787314050/12629dbb5fb46f2b34704b410524/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=c51b195ac605004c7d87e6ac6b0fe54f8bb846595175b23aed9fe9d930a73b2e&amp;req=dScvEcp%2FmYFaWfMW1HO4zSHbI709rGmrHyM86UsCzha89TfOknpEvW2N6cJ0%0AG%2Bl3B3oHr3FjmGxz%2BBc%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_ff376f94e6">Access history of visits </h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787314081/ccf313d27315ba279a50806dd9d8/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=f438ace499b394b71f02395487929663c429de93dadb399c9fd23d51dbd30a49&amp;req=dScvEcp%2FmYFXWPMW1HO4zfqGJYN0vPWLpq1figbsuPLiqgAh5doZ%2BSeBtEuE%0AiEVP1V222e1V3axXh2Q%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12621911-access-control-passes-activated-on-first-use

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you granted studio access to the pass, you&#x27;ll see a new option in the start date options for your pass: <i>Valid from the first use</i>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787438270/a60be4bd7115aa08103cb81630fe/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=90adf2c2c64a5600c04b296ec2a07f83bf3c666b957d70c2a485638f51021b74&amp;req=dScvEc19lYNYWfMW1HO4zZN305Cg475s0xQKJZW3Q50uOp8cKLTMtKuMz%2FuB%0AI1VjV35HrC2LD8hCBs8%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787438270/a60be4bd7115aa08103cb81630fe/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=90adf2c2c64a5600c04b296ec2a07f83bf3c666b957d70c2a485638f51021b74&amp;req=dScvEc19lYNYWfMW1HO4zZN305Cg475s0xQKJZW3Q50uOp8cKLTMtKuMz%2FuB%0AI1VjV35HrC2LD8hCBs8%3D%0A" alt=""/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This option is meant to create &quot;Drop-in passes&quot;. Those passes can be used to give one-day access to members who are not subscribed, for example.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>&quot;Valid from the first use&quot; passes become active when a member checks in for the first time (opens a door to access the studio or scans their barcode) or does a first booking. Then the pass will be valid for the given number of days (a day, a week ...).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_b57a71ddf6">Set up the validity period</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the validity section select &quot;Valid from the 1st use (booking or check-in)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then, define the &quot;Activation period&quot;. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The activation period is the time during which the pass is not activated yet; it&#x27;s waiting for either a first check-in or booking. If the member doesn&#x27;t do any of these actions during the activation period, then the pass will expire.</p></div></li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787437819/037b944f90fa03686f517502789a/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=fbd16af5ab6a6f952647a3feef7540ac2f9d9f89439dadb711b64a1704d6ac68&amp;req=dScvEc19moleUPMW1HO4zUCkLGkXFmCIJnC1KSHysi7ttd6%2FE%2BR1lyVXGRiL%0A3YmhdA1kJyKP6J4qNA0%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1787437819/037b944f90fa03686f517502789a/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=fbd16af5ab6a6f952647a3feef7540ac2f9d9f89439dadb711b64a1704d6ac68&amp;req=dScvEc19moleUPMW1HO4zUCkLGkXFmCIJnC1KSHysi7ttd6%2FE%2BR1lyVXGRiL%0A3YmhdA1kJyKP6J4qNA0%3D%0A" alt=""/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then define the validity period of your pass. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once activated, your pass will become valid for the duration indicated. ### Intercom

<div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Access intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Remember that for Access Control, there are 2 was for your members to enter: </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Manual entry</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Auto entry</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The flow to enter will be different based on which method is used to enter.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_45085e9208">Manual entry</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Note that if you are logged in as an administrator or owner of the studio, you will not be able to scan members, but you will always have access to the live list of members&#x27; visits.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The members checking in at have to:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to their <i>Profile</i> intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_7f11999e83">Goefencing and proximity proof</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the Geofencing or proximity proof feature has been activated, your members will have to allow their phone to share their location. If not, the app will ask them again to accept. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/13671343-which-hardware-to-order-for-access-control-autro-entry

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In order to make sure your Access Control auto-entry installation works as best as possible, it&#x27;s important to have a clear mind the hardware you need to order from Kisi. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_779c3cc29c">Controller (must have)</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The controller is the only must-have piece of hardware for this integration.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This piece of hardware is going to be wired to your door. It does the link between the door and Kisi. This is how Kisi can control your door and send orders to open the door or stay put. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Without this piece of hardware, we cannot make the link between what happens on the software and what happens in the real world. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To know about the controller: </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Controller is <b>free </b>thanks to bsport and Kisi partnership</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can order it <a href="https://kisiconnect.com/products/kisi-controller-pro" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">here</a></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can learn how to install your controller by following Kisi&#x27;s helpsheet:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://docs.kisi.io/access_control/hardware/controllers/kisi_controller_pro_2/install_the_controller_pro_2" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Wire and install your controller</a></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_776da08e27">Reader (optional)</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The reader is only necessary if you want to use proximity proof (<a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11906806-how-to-activate-access-control-auto-entry">see</a>).</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6383499-how-to-create-custom-restrictions-for-group-activities-and-workshop-based-on-tags

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When creating an activity or a workshop, you can indicate the following 3 restrictions : Closing of booking window, Cancellation policy, Opening of booking window.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>With this article, learn how to create <b>special restrictions</b> based on the membership of <b>tag groups</b>. This will allow you, for example, to <b>distinguish the restrictions of your VIP members</b> from your other members, thus giving advantages to VIP members. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>  </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>How to create a personalised restriction : </b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b><i>Step 1 :</i></b><i> Choose an activity or a workshop</i> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>&quot;My Studio&quot; &gt; &quot;Group Activities&quot; or &quot;Workshops&quot; &gt; &quot;Edit&quot; or &quot;Add&quot;. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b><i>Step 2 :</i></b><i> Create a custom restriction </i></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>&quot;Custom restrictions&quot; &gt; Add a rule </p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/546463976/36d3149156fe5b630f367294/Screenshot+2022-07-14+164528.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=1885a1c3901d50d1b6451c5d6439e189b7165ab566186346eeaad8d9922f6d70&amp;req=cSQhEs99lIZZFb4f3HP0gGrOcTujhQqETsnQ7rNjrrZsBEdhNNpsfJLtioa9%0AAY7ZOfw2uTT9xXSyZw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/546463976/36d3149156fe5b630f367294/Screenshot+2022-07-14+164528.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=1885a1c3901d50d1b6451c5d6439e189b7165ab566186346eeaad8d9922f6d70&amp;req=cSQhEs99lIZZFb4f3HP0gGrOcTujhQqETsnQ7rNjrrZsBEdhNNpsfJLtioa9%0AAY7ZOfw2uTT9xXSyZw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1906" height="966"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>&quot;Select a tag&quot; &gt; Select the tag for which you want to create a restriction</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Configure your restriction (Closing of booking window, Cancellation policy, Opening of booking window)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/546465176/516dca07e0e2820cb8518824/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=25b0d2d073089a4b996649bf7d6d1932fd6bb9c07dbe86de4ce863429ee3aa47&amp;req=cSQhEs97nIZZFb4f3HP0gLlKzpteq7C1aC6W7%2B1wxD0ytsCzXqL3Bjvuipcy%0ABA7tqgL9YyYAQojYrw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/546465176/516dca07e0e2820cb8518824/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=25b0d2d073089a4b996649bf7d6d1932fd6bb9c07dbe86de4ce863429ee3aa47&amp;req=cSQhEs97nIZZFb4f3HP0gLlKzpteq7C1aC6W7%2B1wxD0ytsCzXqL3Bjvuipcy%0ABA7tqgL9YyYAQojYrw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1892" height="963"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click on &quot;Save&quot;. </p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Congratulations, your custom restriction has been created ! ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3271433-create-your-workshops

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>There is a difference between activities and workshops regarding the display of the calendar on your website. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To include the calendar on your website, follow this article : <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/4107546">https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/4107546</a></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Step :</b> Create a workshop. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In My Studio &gt; Workshops &gt; Add a workshop. <br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/687382699/7eea2db0abc510f8a55956c3/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=41e0c21846c9b2245cd99b2ed37309e167f3739325dc544f0ce2b351671285d5&amp;req=ciggFcF8m4hWFb4f3HP0gMMyqneAWU0SHUBEmc47BD%2FQ5MTE%2BlunfnHWUCK9%0ApZP1D8p6Y8EPttC0QQ%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/687382699/7eea2db0abc510f8a55956c3/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=41e0c21846c9b2245cd99b2ed37309e167f3739325dc544f0ce2b351671285d5&amp;req=ciggFcF8m4hWFb4f3HP0gMMyqneAWU0SHUBEmc47BD%2FQ5MTE%2BlunfnHWUCK9%0ApZP1D8p6Y8EPttC0QQ%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1898" height="924"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Fill in the form : </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add a picture. </p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add a title.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Enter a category. This tab is important for the choice of the category to set up the pass. The category is invisible for members.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Choose if the workshop is in live streaming class or not. Ticking this will allow you to add visioconference links.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add a color.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add a description.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Define a closing booking time : bookings are available until a certain time before class.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Define a late cancellation time : cancellations are authorized for a certain time before class.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Define a booking opening time : the calendar is open from this period on to book the class. </p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Define the restrictions, if necessary.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then you can create sessions : <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3271716-creation-modification-cancellation-and-deletion-of-sessions-activities-and-workshops">https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3271716</a></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Now you can associate activities and passes. Warning : if a pass already exists, skip this step. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>2nd Step :</b> Follow your workshops.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>By clicking on a workshop, you can modify all these elements, add sessions and see all compatible passes.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Step:</b> Create a lesson plan. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In Products &gt; Pass &gt; Click on &quot;Pass&quot; at the bottom right of the screen. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>2nd Step:</b> Fine-tune the pass. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Enter the following information: </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Name of the pass.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Description (optional)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Name of the category (optional)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Price of the pass including VAT (price that the customer will pay). </p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>VAT</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Number of credits available. Example: A 5-courses pass gives access to 5 credits to reserve 5 courses that cost 1 credit. You can also decide to make your pass unlimited and not restrict the number of credits.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can also choose if you want to allow your members to use this pass for both group activities and appointments by selecting the &quot;Universal pass&quot; option.</p></div></li></ul></div><div <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Universal passes may be used for group activities and appointments. <b>Twin appointment passes are created for every universal pass to link the number of credits</b>. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/7262426-penalties-on-no-show

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Sometimes some of your members do not cancel their session and do not come to it. In order to avoid this type of situation, it is important to be able to make your members aware of the need to cancel their session in good time if they do not wish to attend. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In this sheet, you will learn how to apply penalties to your absent members who used an unlimited pass to make their booking.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b><i>Note:</i></b><i> Penalties are only applicable to unlimited passes.</i></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 1:</b> Apply a penalty on unlimited passes </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To apply these penalties on no-shows, you must indicate it on the unlimited passes. So, go to Product &gt; Passes and create or modify an unlimited pass. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You will then be able to apply a penalty:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To give you time to rectify the situation, absences can be modified for a certain period of time after the roll call has been validated. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>The time between the validation of the roll call and the sending of the email to warn of an absence</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If a member is indicated as absent during a session, an email will automatically be sent to indicate this. intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The <b>pass</b> must be <b>compatible</b> with <b>some Activities and Categories</b> but valid in <b>all the Establishments</b> &gt;&gt; <b>select</b> the <b>Activities and Categories concerned</b> but do <b>NOT</b> select <b>any Establishment</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The <b>pass</b> must be <b>compatible</b> with <b>all the Activities</b> but <b>only in one Establishment</b> &gt;&gt; do <b>NOT select Activities and Categories</b> but <b>select</b> the <b>Establishment</b> in which this pass will be usable </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The <b>pass</b> must be <b>compatible</b> with <b>all the Activities of </b>the<b> same Category </b>&gt;&gt; <b>classify</b> <b>all</b> the <b>Activities</b> in question <b>in the same Category</b> and <b>only select the Category in question</b> in the compatibility of the pass (no need to add the Activities if the pass must be compatible with all the Activities of this Category)</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The <b>pass</b> must be <b>compatible</b> with <b>Activities classified in different Categories</b> &gt;&gt; <b>select only</b> the <b>Activities in question</b> <b>OR</b> select the <b>Activities and all the Categories</b> <b>linked to these Activities</b> (as soon as a Category is selected, only the Activities of the selected Categories will be compatible)</p></div><section class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/10963144-understanding-stripe-payouts-with-bsport-a-complete-guide

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Managing payouts efficiently is essential for businesses using <b>Bsport and Stripe Connect</b>. As a <b>Bsport client</b>, your transactions are processed through Stripe, and payouts are sent based on <b>a structured payout schedule</b>. This guide explains:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>How payouts work</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>Processing times for different payment methods</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>Payout schedules (daily, weekly, and monthly)</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>How refunds &amp; disputes impact your payouts</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>How to track your payouts easily</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_7e8a604dec"><b>🔹 1. How Do Stripe Payouts Work with Bsport?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When a customer pays for a service or membership at your business, the funds <b>do not go directly to your bank account</b>. Instead, they go through a <b>Stripe Connect Account</b>, which we manage on your behalf.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 <b>Bsport handles all Stripe transactions and manages your payouts.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_d49160f499"><b>⚙️ The Payout Process:</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>1️⃣ <b>Customer makes a payment</b> (via credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, etc.).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>2️⃣ <b>Funds are first received by your Stripe Connect Account.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>3️⃣ <b>After processing and verification</b>, the funds are scheduled for payout.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>4️⃣ <b>Stripe transfers the payout to your bank account</b> according to your <b>payout schedule</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>📌 <b>Important:</b> Your customers’ payments are <b>NOT instantly available</b> in your bank account. They must first go through <b>Stripe’s processing period and payout delay</b> (explained below).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_07bcbfa53a"><b>⏳ 2. Payment Processing Time: SEPA vs. Credit Cards</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_c08c19764b"><b>💳 Credit Card Payments</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Processed instantly</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ Once the payment is processed, Stripe applies a <b>payout delay</b> for security and fraud prevention.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_72794b9d71"><b>🏦 SEPA Direct Debit Payments</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⏳ <b>Take at least 3 working days</b> to be validated</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>🔄 Available for payout <b>only after processing is complete</b>, subject to the Payout Delay.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 <b>Example:</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>SEPA payment made on Monday</b> is completed by Thursday at the earliest.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>credit card payment made on Monday</b> is processed instantly but <b>available for payout only after the configured Payout Delay</b>.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_52c849cfff"><b>🚀 3. Understanding Payout Delay (T+3 Days Minimum)</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Stripe applies a <b>payout delay</b> for security and fraud prevention on all online transactions. This means that a payment via credit card is available <b>at least 3 days later</b>, the same for SEPA payments, on top of the time needed for validation (as explained above).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Minimum delay: 3 days</b> (this cannot be reduced).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ This delay ensures the payment is <b>legitimate</b> before being released.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ Even if you are on <b>daily payouts</b>, this delay still applies.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>🚨 <b>Even with daily payouts, you will not receive a same-day payout for transactions made that day!</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_f9b32c562f"><b>📅 4. Choosing Your Payout Frequency</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can <b>customize</b> how often Stripe sends payouts to your bank:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-table"><table><tbody><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Payout Frequency</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>How It Works</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Best For</b></p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Daily Payouts</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Funds that complete the payout delay are sent every day</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>High-volume businesses</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Weekly Payouts</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Payouts are collected from a Thursday morning until the following Wednesday night. They are then sent <b>every Friday</b>; funds arrive <b>Monday</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Most businesses</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Monthly Payouts</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You choose a <b>specific day</b> each month</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Long-term cash flow planning</p></div></td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 <b>Weekly payouts are the most common because they balance cash flow and processing time.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_578f8584b6"><b>🔄 5. What Transactions Are Included in Your Payout?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A payout <b>only includes transactions that have cleared Stripe’s processing time</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_27a19d21c9"><b>🗓️ Weekly Payouts - Example Breakdown</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If your payout is <b>scheduled for Monday</b>, it will include:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Transactions made <b>Thursday (last week) – Wednesday (this week)</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Payout is <b>sent Friday, arrives Monday</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-table"><table><tbody><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Transaction Date</b></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Included in Payout?</b></p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Thursday (last week)</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ Yes</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Monday (this week)</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ Yes</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Friday (this week)</p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>❌ No (Will be in next week’s payout)</p></div></td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_772ab5b1ed"><b>💰 6. Refunds &amp; Disputes: How They Impact Payouts</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Refunds are deducted from your next payout</b> automatically.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Disputes (chargebacks) are also deducted</b> if lost.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>If your balance becomes negative</b>, Stripe will <b>block future refunds</b> until positive.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_ca9fe9215f"><b>📌 Example: Refund Deduction</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Expected Payout: 1,000€</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Refund Issued: 300€</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Final Payout: 700€</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>🚨 <b>If your balance is negative, Stripe may withhold future payouts or require additional funds to cover the deficit.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_9b931e2075"><b>📊 7. Tracking Your Payouts in the Bsport Dashboard</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can check <b>what payments are included in a payout</b> directly from your Bsport Back Office.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_18786a18be"><b>🛠️ How to Check Payout Details</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>1️⃣ <b>Go to</b> <b>Settings → Bsport Subscription</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>2️⃣ Find the <b>list of payouts</b> at the top.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>3️⃣ Copy the <b>reference number</b> under the payout amount.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>4️⃣ <b>Go to Reporting → Payment</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>5️⃣ In the filter section:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click <b>Year-to-Date</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click <b>Add a Quick Filter</b> → Choose <b>Transfer</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Paste the <b>reference number</b>.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✅ <b>This will show all transactions included in that payout.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>🚨 <b>If the reference number is missing, contact Bsport support.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/10969222-how-to-update-my-information-on-b2b-and-b2c-invoices

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_ad0a9f1b0e"><b>Updating Business Information for B2C Invoices</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>(<i>Your studio invoicing its members</i>)</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If your studio sends invoices to your members, the information displayed on those invoices comes from <b>your Stripe account settings</b>. You need to ensure that your <b>company name, business address, and registration details</b> are correctly configured.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_569c83d17d"><b>📌 Step 1: Update Business Information in Stripe</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To modify your company information on invoices:</p></div><div Information</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This will open the <b>Stripe interface</b>, where you can The commercial name, if different from the legal name (<b>see screenshot, point 2</b>).</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Business Address</b> – Your registered address (<b>see screenshot, point 3</b>).</p></div></li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Proof of ID (front and back).</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>✔ <b>Email address and phone number.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 Invoices</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To update your company name, address, or VAT details on <b>bsport invoices</b>, follow name).</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Business phone number.</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/12441759-new-vat-rules-for-eu-clients-starting-october-2025

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>From <b>October 2025</b>, Bsport will apply new VAT rules to some of our EU clients. This change is required by law and applies to all companies and associations using Bsport in the European Union (outside France) <b>who do not have a valid intra-community VAT number</b> registered in their back-office.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_cb88fedb19"><b>Why is this changing?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Bsport provides software-as-a-service (SaaS), which the European Union classifies as an “electronically supplied service” (our software platform). According to EU law, electronic services must be taxed differently depending on whether the client provides a valid intra-community VAT number (often called an “<b>EU VAT number</b>” or “<b>VIES</b>”).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you have a valid <b>intra-community VAT number (EU VAT)</b> → no VAT is applied to your invoice. You are considered a taxable business. Bsport will issue your invoices without VAT, and you will declare the VAT yourself in your own country (this is called the “reverse-charge mechanism”).</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you do <b>not</b> have a valid intra-community VAT number → You are considered a non-taxable person (like a consumer). In this case, Bsport is required to add VAT to your invoices at your country’s local rate (e.g. Germany 19%, Spain 21%, Italy 22%).<br/>​<br/>​</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This is not a new rule: it comes directly from the <b>EU VAT Directive (2006/112/EC, Article 58)</b> and the VAT e-commerce package that entered into force on 1 July 2021.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>From <b>October 2025</b>, Bsport will fully apply these rules in all cases. This is not a decision made by Bsport, but a <b>legal requirement for all software providers in the EU</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>VAT vs. EU VAT: What’s the difference?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>VAT (Value Added Tax):</b> A consumption tax applied in every EU country (e.g. Germany 19%, Spain 21%, Italy 22%).</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>EU VAT / Intra-community VAT number:</b> A special <b>tax identification number</b> that exempts businesses (and some associations) from VAT when purchasing services across EU borders.<br/>​<br/>​</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>👉 Simply put: Having a <b>VAT number from your national tax authority registered in the EU VIES system</b> allows you to avoid VAT charges on Bsport invoices.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><a href="https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/#/vat-validation" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/#/vat-validation</a></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_1b1ce34439"><b>What does this mean for you?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>EU companies without an EU VAT number</b> → VAT will be charged at your local rate.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>EU companies with a valid EU VAT number</b> → No VAT will be charged.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>EU Associations:<br/>​<br/>​</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the association has an EU VAT number → No VAT will be charged.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If the association does <b>not</b> have an EU VAT number → VAT must be charged, as the association is considered an “end consumer”.</p></div></li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_2f74ed7c67"><b>In which cases VAT will not be charged</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>EU clients without EU VAT</b>: VAT will be charged at the local rate.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Associations with no VAT number</b>: VAT will be charged.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Non-EU clients</b> (UK, Switzerland, USA, Canada, etc.): No VAT will be charged, as they are outside EU VAT rules.<br/>​<br/>​</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_b1710dac91"><b>Will this cost me more?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>For businesses and VAT-registered associations</b>: No. VAT is not a cost; it can be reclaimed via your local tax return.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>For associations and entities not registered for VAT</b>: Yes, VAT is a cost, since only VAT-registered entities can recover it.<br/>​<br/>​</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_b763b07d9b"><b>What should you do now?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Log in to your <b>back-office</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to <b>Settings &gt; Company &gt; VAT identification number</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Enter your valid intra-community VAT number.</p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ If you don’t have one yet, apply quickly with your local tax authority. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1. What if I get my VAT number after October 2025?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you enter a valid EU VAT number after October, VAT will stop being applied to future invoices. For past invoices, you can reclaim VAT through your local tax return with your accountant.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>2. I already entered my VAT number, how do I know if it’s valid?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Your VAT number must be valid in the EU VIES system. If it’s invalid, VAT will still be charged. You can check validity here: VIES EU Validation Tool.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>3. I am outside the EU, do I need to do anything?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>No. Clients outside the EU (e.g. UK, Switzerland, USA) are not charged VAT.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>4. I am a French association with VAT exemption, do I pay VAT?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you are exempt, you must send us an attestation de non-assujettissement. Without this, French VAT will apply.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>5. Can I recover VAT charged on Bsport invoices?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Yes, if you are VAT-registered. Your accountant will reclaim it through your VAT return. Associations or non-VAT-registered entities cannot recover VAT.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>6. How long does it take to get an EU VAT number?</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The process depends on your country, but typically takes 3–8 weeks depending on the country.
