<div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_6b1962a4cf">What is VeriFactu?</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>VeriFactu is the electronic invoicing system introduced by the Spanish Tax Agency to ensure traceability, transparency, and authenticity in business transactions. Its main goal is to guarantee that all issued invoices are recorded and reported to the Tax Agency in real or near real time, helping to prevent tax fraud and simplify compliance for businesses.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In this guide, we’ll explain how to activate the integration with VeriFactu through Fiskaly, our fiscal partner that allows you to connect your invoicing system to the Spanish Tax Agency easily, automatically, and securely.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#feedaf80;border-color:#fbc91633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The integration has to be activated, please reach out to your Account Manager to activate it.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#fed9db80;border-color:#fd3a5733"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For now, TicketBai is not supported (Basque Country).</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_6b8d0cccf7">Introduction</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In order to be able to sign your invoices you must complete all the following steps and prerequisites. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Invoices created before completing theses steps won&#x27;t be sent automatically. You&#x27;ll have to do it manually.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_dcf9204d49">1. Spanish Electronic Certificate</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The first step of this integration is to obtain your Spanish Electronic Certification. Invoice Eligibility for Verifactu</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>An invoice can be sent to Verifactu <b>if and only if</b> all of the following conditions are met:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice is <b>opened or a refund </b>invoice</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Meaning the invoice has a PDF </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For example, subscriptions have draft invoices (for future ones), these are not opened invoices</p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>It doesn&#x27;t mean the invoice has been paid</p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice is <b>not voided</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice does <b>not come from a migration</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice contains <b>at least one invoice item</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice is <b>not</b> a partial refund from a payment pack</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If any of these conditions are not met, the invoice will not be sent to Verifactu.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_22c32cfcc9">4. Invoice Signature Flows</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In order to send an invoice to taxe authorities we first make sure that the invoice has the right information. Invoices with wrong information will be <b>rejected by tax authorities</b> and it <b>won&#x27;t be possible to send them again</b>. This is why we do a first check before sending the invoices.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Reminder: </b>all invoices generated before the full integration set up are not sent to the Spanish Tax Agency.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once onboarding is complete, <b>eligible invoices are automatically sent to Verifactu upon finalization</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Sending an invoice can:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Succeed</b>, or</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Fail</b> (before Verifactu processes it)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This status reflects the ability to send the invoice, not its final registration result.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_f7cd8ce8ae">5. Failed Invoice Sending</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>For invoices ≥ 400€ (tax included)</b>, Verifactu requires information about the invoice recipient (the member).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Missing information about the recipient is the most common source of errors. Here is the information needed:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Recipient country</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>City</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Zip code</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If Spanish recipient: <b>NIF</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If non-Spanish recipient: <b>official identification document</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When information is missing:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice cannot be sent</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You must complete the missing information</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>They go back to the invoice and click <b>“Try Again”</b> to retry submission</p></div></li></ul></div><div intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Verifactu processing may take up to <b>3 minutes</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Status updates automatically after refresh</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_70f26f796b">6.2 Registered</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice has been correctly registered with Spanish tax authorities</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_010081045f">6.3 Rejected</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The invoice was not accepted by Verifactu.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Common reasons</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Invalid Spanish NIF (for invoices ≥ 400€)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In this ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/11426418-tse-integration-with-fiskaly

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To comply with German law, all cash register systems must be connected to a <b>TSE (technical security system)</b>. The goal is to prevent any manipulation of sales data after it has been recorded.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>At bsport, we’ve integrated with <b>fiskaly</b>, the first company certified by the German Federal Cyber Security Authority with maximum validity for a cloud-based TSE solution. fiskaly handles the secure, tamper-proof signing of your transactions, keeping your studio compliant with KassenSichV.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This guide walks you through everything you need to know as a studio manager.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_a2811738ba">🔧 1. <b>Activating fiskaly in the Backoffice</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Enabling fiskaly is quick and easy:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Log into your bsport Backoffice</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Navigate to <b>Settings &gt; bsport subscription &gt; Available Add-ons</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Locate the <b>fiskaly TSE integration</b> upsell</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click <b>See more, </b>tick the confirmation checkbox, and click <b>Confirm</b></p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Your TSE environment will be automatically created. No technical setup is needed: you can start using your compliant register immediately.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 Note: The TSE integration is a <b>paid add-on</b> to cover the cost of our certified third-party provider, fiskaly.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_bb4dac2c28">🧾 2. <b>What happens when you create an invoice?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When an invoice is generated on bsport:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A transaction is initiated in the fiskaly system</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>There is no visible change at this stage</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 Think of it as starting the legal record, but not finalising it yet.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_5b47090f85">💳 3. <b>What happens when the invoice is paid?</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When the customer pays:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>fiskaly <b>signs the transaction: it can no longer be altered</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>QR code</b> appears on the PDF receipt</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>chip</b> displays on the invoice page in your Backoffice</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This confirms that the record of the transaction is now tamper-proof.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1536006166/61bf8c20950da2e5cf691531d901/Sent-to-fiskaly.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=e4870f6666b1b70d402b43edb340000876f648543b84b08cd5d05a5b606a25ea&amp;req=dSUkEMl%2Bm4BZX%2FMW1HO4zYJs3bK7tGJydua2NiT5Rta7FTV8tNpv6T5eI6Qv%0A0A9OiCnxw5YFkamF7PU%3D%0A" no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A link to <b>bsport’s Procedural Documentation</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_5f4ba8bf9a">🕵️ 5. <b>In case of an audit</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you&#x27;re audited by German tax authorities:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Contact your Account Manager to export your ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/13529640-how-to-set-up-sequential-invoice-numbering

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In some countries, invoices must follow a sequential numbering system to ensure proper accounting and prevent fraud.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you’re already using bsport and haven’t set this up yet, this article explains <b>how and when to activate sequential invoice numbering</b> for your studio.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>👉 <b>If you already filled in your invoice numbering during onboarding, you don’t need to do anything.</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_098a53ec06">What is sequential invoice numbering?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Sequential invoice numbering means that each new invoice gets a number that follows the previous one, without gaps or duplicates.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>On bsport, an invoice number can include:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>prefix</b> (optional)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>date</b> (year, or year + month — mandatory)</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>sequential number</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A <b>suffix</b> (optional)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Example:<br/>​<code>INV-2026-000004-FR</code></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#feedaf80;border-color:#fbc91633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ <b>Important note: </b>Once this numbering is set up, <b>it cannot be edited</b>.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_4c31117970">Who needs to set this up?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You need to take action if:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Your studio was created <b>before this feature existed</b>, and</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You haven’t defined your invoice numbering yet.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If your studio is new and you already completed this step during onboarding, you’re all set ✅</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you already asked for sequential numbering to be done by bsport in the past, you will not be able to change the numbering from the back office.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_f3a5299f59">Where to set up invoice numbering</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to <b>Settings &gt; Billing</b> in your bsport back office</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to the <b>Invoice numbering</b> section</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Define your numbering format (prefix, date, suffix)</p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1994145965/fe7a58e1f40ecce9aa8ec12a4f1d/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=1ed99f0d2bd44311d2773e3e1bb7ec86338b148643c61223c8167ec86ad7fb76&amp;req=dSkuEsh6mIhZXPMW1HO4zbVepxCzkwKPzh2inPGVOnHiKQJzbzas8GlPdwwg%0AW%2BFPWdyh0y4SEMgJvvc%3D%0A" src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/1994145965/fe7a58e1f40ecce9aa8ec12a4f1d/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=1ed99f0d2bd44311d2773e3e1bb7ec86338b148643c61223c8167ec86ad7fb76&amp;req=dSkuEsh6mIhZXPMW1HO4zbVepxCzkwKPzh2inPGVOnHiKQJzbzas8GlPdwwg%0AW%2BFPWdyh0y4SEMgJvvc%3D%0A" alt="" width="2924" height="1586"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Once confirmed, this <b>configuration is locked</b> and will apply automatically based on the start date you choose.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_fe1a2f313e">Choose when sequential numbering should start</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You’ll be asked to select <b>when</b> sequential numbering should apply.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#feedaf80;border-color:#fbc91633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ <b>Important note: </b>Once this numbering is set up, <b>it cannot be edited</b>.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_3426d29cee">Option 1: Beginning of next month (recommended)</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This option is ideal if you <b>don’t use external accounting software</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>All invoices created <b>before next month</b> keep their current ID</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Invoices created <b>from next month onward</b> will use sequential numbering</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The numbering will start at <b>1</b></p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_eead655b0c">Option 2: Beginning of current month</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This option is mainly for studios that <b>already use external accounting software</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Sequential numbering is applied retroactively to invoices created since the start of the current month</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the interface, existing invoices will display the new sequential number</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Invoice PDFs created in the past will still show their original ID</b> (PDFs cannot be edited)</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>All new invoices will have the correct sequential number both in the interface and on the PDF.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_b15ac48ac6">Using an external accounting software?</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you recreate bsport invoices in another accounting tool, you can make sure both systems stay aligned.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>First select &quot;Beginning of current month&quot; as start date</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Then, enable the option <b>“I use an external accounting provider”</b></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Choose the <b>starting number</b> for bsport invoices</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a ### Intercom

<div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_7e2be162ff">Prerequisites</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Access to the invoice details page in <i>Billing &gt; Invoices</i></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>An existing invoice</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2183985086/81d4f405a61d919412a29f3cba70/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=99a0b4b60864cea456f6149061616571f138ecdac03b24527630bc8180bb70e5&amp;req=diEvFcB2mIFXX%2FMW1HO4zTxog4m7dbOvoR2Db8eSkmECTTLvVpWptWREKJTW%0AlnUElEDtSsd3mLU3yOc%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2183985086/81d4f405a61d919412a29f3cba70/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=99a0b4b60864cea456f6149061616571f138ecdac03b24527630bc8180bb70e5&amp;req=diEvFcB2mIFXX%2FMW1HO4zTxog4m7dbOvoR2Db8eSkmECTTLvVpWptWREKJTW%0AlnUElEDtSsd3mLU3yOc%3D%0A" alt="" width="832" height="613"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_162be975d7">Detailed explanation</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>On the invoice details page, several payment amounts are displayed. Each one reflects a different stage of the payment process.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_7470f75390">1. Total due</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This is the total amount of the invoice.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>It corresponds to the full price that must be paid.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276581631/2282d69ea9ca7183b618cb180e1d/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_30_42.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d44a989014ccda6b34045d87de0286ac5d6245c8fe100684a73806bcf6b79bd5&amp;req=diIgEMx2nIdcWPMW1HO4zaEjjLrzsXvfYLdXRtsAt%2F1svTQH%2F7zx40WMu01I%0AGUgX%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276581631/2282d69ea9ca7183b618cb180e1d/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_30_42.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d44a989014ccda6b34045d87de0286ac5d6245c8fe100684a73806bcf6b79bd5&amp;req=diIgEMx2nIdcWPMW1HO4zaEjjLrzsXvfYLdXRtsAt%2F1svTQH%2F7zx40WMu01I%0AGUgX%0A" alt="" width="1667" height="744"/></a></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_419357093e">2. Payment received</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This is the total amount already paid successfully.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>These payments are confirmed and cannot fail.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276585562/620fdd668618defbfd762d74cc9b/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_31_40.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2a144b5df64dd630cda7367148597deb88f9c94ebf350982e5f372d985e29f3b&amp;req=diIgEMx2mIRZW%2FMW1HO4zdMvuPsA0YibjbBGUwFGHxldSSv%2FU2oLq5ZcG%2FtP%0AD5G5%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276585562/620fdd668618defbfd762d74cc9b/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_31_40.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=2a144b5df64dd630cda7367148597deb88f9c94ebf350982e5f372d985e29f3b&amp;req=diIgEMx2mIRZW%2FMW1HO4zdMvuPsA0YibjbBGUwFGHxldSSv%2FU2oLq5ZcG%2FtP%0AD5G5%0A" alt="" width="1674" height="756"/></a></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_c1eb6f85b2">3. Payment planned</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This is the total of future scheduled payments.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>These payments have not yet been attempted (e.g. instalments).<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276590667/ec2dba0b92e50abe6128d26f31b8/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_33_13.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=b9a38c51e6c53abaf8fcec5afb8c5753396d5cf404923857e1f83a68b089d098&amp;req=diIgEMx3nYdZXvMW1HO4zVT59BgTvT2%2FxMC3BWW4b1URxOxEmmXLoKOYejRh%0Ank0U%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2276590667/ec2dba0b92e50abe6128d26f31b8/Screenshot+2026-04-15+at+10_33_13.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=b9a38c51e6c53abaf8fcec5afb8c5753396d5cf404923857e1f83a68b089d098&amp;req=diIgEMx3nYdZXvMW1HO4zVT59BgTvT2%2FxMC3BWW4b1URxOxEmmXLoKOYejRh%0Ank0U%0A" alt="" width="1672" height="825"/></a></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_f39be2df4c">4. Payment pending</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This includes payments currently being processed.<br/>For example:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>SEPA direct debit</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>BACS payments</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#feedaf80;border-color:#fbc91633"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ These payments can still fail.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_393b0ce958">5. Payment outstanding</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This is the remaining amount to be paid.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>It is calculated as: <b><i>Total due – (Payment received + Payment planned + Payment pending)</i></b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>👉 If this amount is greater than 0, the invoice is not fully covered.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_7fcc09a767">Example</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>For a 100€ invoice:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Initially:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>No payments → <b>100€ outstanding</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>After setting up 10 instalments of 10€:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>100€ planned → <b>0€ outstanding</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If one payment is processing:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>80€ planned + 20€ pending → still <b>0€ outstanding</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If one payment succeeds:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>20€ received + 80€ planned → still <b>0€ outstanding</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If one payment fails:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>20€ received + 70€ planned → <b>10€ outstanding</b></p></div></li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-horizontal-rule"><hr/></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_c4449a40b8">Additional information</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>⚠️ <b>Important</b><br/>If <b>Payment outstanding &gt; 0</b>, the invoice is overdue. An action is required (manual payment or retry).</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>💡 <b>Good to know</b><br/>A failed planned payment creates the same situation as a canceled one, with the failed attempt visible in the payment list.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_814f0cbf40"></h2></div><section class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 related_articles my-6"><hr class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_ef2c7528dd">Steps to export invoices</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div It contains:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_410e5bf6b1">📄 One PDF per invoice</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Each PDF is named: <code>YYYY-MM-DD_[invoice-number]_[type].pdf</code></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Examples:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><code>2025-03-15_INV-000123_invoice.pdf</code></p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><code>2025-03-20_CN-000456_credit-note.pdf</code></p></div></li></ul></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The date in the filename is the invoice issue date, displayed in <b>your studio&#x27;s local timezone</b>.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_d882e2f6b9">📊 A CSV file </h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Named <code>invoices_manifest.csv</code>, this spreadsheet lists every invoice in the export. It includes:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-table"><table><tbody><tr><td style="background-color:#e8e8e880"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Column</p></div></td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e880"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Description</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><code>invoice_number</code></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Invoice or credit note number</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><code>issue_date</code></p></div></td><td><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Date and time the invoice was issued (in your timezone)</p></div></td></tr><tr><td><div <div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_a814ba9a38">How to Manage and Disable SEPA Payments in bsport</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area) payments are a common method for processing transactions in bsport. This guide explains how to manage and disable SEPA payments, whether for new transactions or existing subscriptions, and clarifies the implications of disabling SEPA.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_ce32bc985a">Overview of SEPA Payments</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>SEPA payments allow for efficient and standardised euro transactions across participating countries. In bsport, SEPA can be used for both one-time payments and recurring subscriptions. However, there may be scenarios where you need to disable SEPA as a payment method or stop automatic SEPA payments for specific subscriptions.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_b67491cd7a">Disabling SEPA as a Payment Method</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To prevent SEPA from being used for future transactions, such as trial sessions or new subscriptions, follow these steps:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Navigate to <b>Settings &gt; Payment Methods</b> in the Bsport dashboard.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Locate the SEPA payment option.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Turn off or uncheck the SEPA payment method to disable it for future use.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2258908309/51f4384a92ca7d1e709a109ee126/Screenshot+2026-04-10+at+16_15_30.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=50f0e6772301565836dc766d62ffa5d7a9484ea891c2e636fbaa59bf6af1bea1&amp;req=diIiHsB%2BlYJfUPMW1HO4zdbZvbIYeoI2PQ9qSpUvYIsRWRd67HKHToOpVWLu%0AFWRM%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/q6foivp2/2258908309/51f4384a92ca7d1e709a109ee126/Screenshot+2026-04-10+at+16_15_30.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=50f0e6772301565836dc766d62ffa5d7a9484ea891c2e636fbaa59bf6af1bea1&amp;req=diIiHsB%2BlYJfUPMW1HO4zdbZvbIYeoI2PQ9qSpUvYIsRWRd67HKHToOpVWLu%0AFWRM%0A" alt="" width="2144" height="1034"/></a></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This action ensures that SEPA will no longer be available as a payment option for members making new purchases via the Member portal or app. However, staff can still process SEPA payments manually from the Back Office if needed.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_36174fb1b0">Managing SEPA for Existing Subscriptions</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you need to stop automatic SEPA direct debit payments for an existing subscription, follow these steps:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Open the bsport dashboard and go to <b>Transactions &gt; Direct Debits</b>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the list of active subscriptions, locate the relevant invoice and click the pencil icon to edit it.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Select <b>View Invoice</b> to access the payment details.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the <b>Payment Scheduled</b> section, click the three dots next to the customer’s instalment.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Choose <b>Deactivate</b> to cancel the automatic SEPA payment.<br/>​</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a **URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/3528023-create-a-smartlist

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>1st Step: </b>Create a smartlist. Smartlists in bsport are a powerful tool for organising and targeting clients based on specific criteria. They allow you to dynamically group clients based on filters such as attendance, membership type, or activity level, enabling targeted communication and efficient client management.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Navigate to <b>Marketing &gt; Smartlists</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Click on <b>Add a Smartlist</b>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/233120970/dbf2bb7848babfef432eeb36/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=08db2988712754eaf7f72131dbccdea3d2dd2ebda20467f5ba1203041a8de78f&amp;req=diMkF8t%2BlIZfFb4f3HP0gBqVaWEckpWAtj%2B7h6%2BQIhfJKadw9czdxPFrXQPw%0Ak3fupSrQbSRsRIp2sA%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/233120970/dbf2bb7848babfef432eeb36/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=08db2988712754eaf7f72131dbccdea3d2dd2ebda20467f5ba1203041a8de78f&amp;req=diMkF8t%2BlIZfFb4f3HP0gBqVaWEckpWAtj%2B7h6%2BQIhfJKadw9czdxPFrXQPw%0Ak3fupSrQbSRsRIp2sA%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1440" height="737"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Enter the name of the list &gt; Add a description &gt; Click on &quot;Save&quot;. ### Intercom

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Elevate your communication with members through our cutting-edge messaging interface, seamlessly integrating multiple communication methods.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This interface is available to communicate with your session participants, reaching out to those who have booked, cancelled, or are eagerly awaiting a spot.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>With the inbox add-on, it becomes possible to use this interface for 2-way communication with individual members, smartlists, or sessions. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/8173987-manage-your-messages-with-the-inbox

<div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#e3e7fa80;border-color:#334bfa33"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b><i>The inbox feature is an add-on. To request the activation of the inbox, you can follow this <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6078826-request-the-integration-of-an-add-on">guide on add-on integration</a>.</i></b></p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This article details the functionalities of the inbox feature, which regroups all conversations with members, smartlists and sessions in one place. It assumes you are already familiar with the new messaging interface, whose functionalities are detailed in <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/8172973-messaging-interface">this article</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-callout" style="background-color:#d7efdc80;border-color:#1bb15733"><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To make full use of the inbox, we recommend that you activate the setting to <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/8267450-receive-answers-by-email-on-the-platform">receive answers by email on the platform</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Please note that communication using SMS is an add-on. If you&#x27;re in the US, UK or Canada, you can also receive answers from your members with 2-way SMS. To activate it, follow our <a href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/6078826-request-the-integration-of-an-add-on">guide on add-on integration</a>.</p></div></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_2303a7129d">General structure</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In the inbox, each conversation with a member, session or smartlist is called a thread. The inbox is split into 3 parts:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-ordered-nested-list"><ol><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The thread list section displays a list of threads ordered by the time since their last message. In this section, you can <a href="#h_1eaa10691f">select a category of threads</a>, <a href="#h_eac6ddf63b">filter by status</a>, <a href="#h_27f22d972b">search for a specific thread</a>, <a href="#h_ea12830700">start a new thread</a>, and <a href="#h_f9288b6253">change the status of each thread</a>.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The chat section displays the history of messages for the selected thread. It is also in this section that you write and send new messages.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>The details section, collapsible, displays all the relevant information about the member, smartlist or session you&#x27;re messaging.</p></div></li></ol></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_ea12830700">Start a new thread</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To start a new thread from the inbox, click on the pencil button. Its behaviour will depend on which category of threads is selected: members, smartlists or sessions.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/797935476/08df0ad1d8c31dbfb59adf0e/start-thread2.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=5252d275b82f735dc6661d4f91e1fbdb3f5b3b0166421c432d904aa66c0385ab&amp;req=cykgH8p7mYZZFb4f3HP0gC06rVOlfX3FN395vmCB9fB2bB8DUVCam5FbemYa%0AI7KBMi7IBf8AVNGWJw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/797935476/08df0ad1d8c31dbfb59adf0e/start-thread2.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=5252d275b82f735dc6661d4f91e1fbdb3f5b3b0166421c432d904aa66c0385ab&amp;req=cykgH8p7mYZZFb4f3HP0gC06rVOlfX3FN395vmCB9fB2bB8DUVCam5FbemYa%0AI7KBMi7IBf8AVNGWJw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1920" height="967"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_a2a689c4d2">Start a thread with a member</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A pop-up will display a search bar. Use it to select the member you want to communicate with: you can look up members by their first name, last name, email or phone number.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792920147/551e61d3ff637aace92c6650/Screenshot+2023-07-25+at+14-24-47+Backoffice+-+bsport.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d6a52c9f3613e7a89ec406fab4a2676811b198775762ddb3b86e45547498c054&amp;req=cyklH8t%2BnIVYFb4f3HP0gIa1ZmU9WYsbSotqbW0Swv%2FsPeOFQBXe0wOEI3qs%0AHpJV9aqFjZXdx8tvPw%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792920147/551e61d3ff637aace92c6650/Screenshot+2023-07-25+at+14-24-47+Backoffice+-+bsport.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d6a52c9f3613e7a89ec406fab4a2676811b198775762ddb3b86e45547498c054&amp;req=cyklH8t%2BnIVYFb4f3HP0gIa1ZmU9WYsbSotqbW0Swv%2FsPeOFQBXe0wOEI3qs%0AHpJV9aqFjZXdx8tvPw%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1920" height="967"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_1404265a0b">Start a thread with a smartlist</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A pop-up will display a selector with a list of existing smartlists. There&#x27;s also an option to create a new smartlist.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811915842/4ee88d3c872b4e05eab287a6/Screenshot+2023-08-21+at+12-14-25+Inbox.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d3d9c57416edc47fd4351c654e10a722c8ee57148795dad97448cfe15e82ed07&amp;req=fCEmH8h7lYVdFb4f3HP0gIr2onlsgMiXGl7WoEGoo6eQAqh0HbX5X0yf3PW5%0Aj1ICFtMrY7JmFR6WhQ%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811915842/4ee88d3c872b4e05eab287a6/Screenshot+2023-08-21+at+12-14-25+Inbox.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=d3d9c57416edc47fd4351c654e10a722c8ee57148795dad97448cfe15e82ed07&amp;req=fCEmH8h7lYVdFb4f3HP0gIr2onlsgMiXGl7WoEGoo6eQAqh0HbX5X0yf3PW5%0Aj1ICFtMrY7JmFR6WhQ%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="644" height="252"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_2a1ae0e2cf">Start a thread with a session</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You are redirected to a calendar view. Navigate this calendar to select the desired session.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811917057/66badcd71cc69c5d4183698a/Screenshot+2023-08-21+at+12-16-33+Inbox.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=bc787d2e88d00fb87fb94a79392ecefaca8bdd2d0fed106ff75912aebaacc2af&amp;req=fCEmH8h5nYRYFb4f3HP0gGbLGI74je1LNOE3XHUt7JMBqjQ4zBih9woVC2ln%0AMUTX1Mxo1KUdIDGWSg%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811917057/66badcd71cc69c5d4183698a/Screenshot+2023-08-21+at+12-16-33+Inbox.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=bc787d2e88d00fb87fb94a79392ecefaca8bdd2d0fed106ff75912aebaacc2af&amp;req=fCEmH8h5nYRYFb4f3HP0gGbLGI74je1LNOE3XHUt7JMBqjQ4zBih9woVC2ln%0AMUTX1Mxo1KUdIDGWSg%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1004" height="734"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_f9288b6253">Actions on threads</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can change the status of a thread by clicking on the &quot;...&quot; button on a thread item. 4 options are available:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Mark as read</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Add to favourites</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Mute</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Archive</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_d00ed3f3f8">Mark a thread as unread</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792916656/5e1e1b070a7901a1d0c55dfa/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+173951.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3e22ea1909f58a4660fd20691cc3e95b9cd17fa26146f58d447ba2d6bfbd93b8&amp;req=cyklH8h4m4RZFb4f3HP0gAxSnZ7wcxjVSllunVCk03hE3NeR4BULrlUO6NS2%0A4CklOZmkV335Dr8RhQ%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792916656/5e1e1b070a7901a1d0c55dfa/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+173951.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=3e22ea1909f58a4660fd20691cc3e95b9cd17fa26146f58d447ba2d6bfbd93b8&amp;req=cyklH8h4m4RZFb4f3HP0gAxSnZ7wcxjVSllunVCk03hE3NeR4BULrlUO6NS2%0A4CklOZmkV335Dr8RhQ%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="508" height="472"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>This option is only available for threads that have been read. It is useful in case you want to remind yourself of reading this thread later.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When a thread is marked as unread, the last message is treated as unread and therefore the thread item displays a red chip with 1 as the number of unread messages.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_f374a002fb">Add a thread to Favourites</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792921121/404cb8368b3daed0c0722b9a/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174002.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=7cd7b652aad2c8126142e8f68e1a0bdea1521d321bec70f7f208b39ca007fed9&amp;req=cyklH8t%2FnINeFb4f3HP0gC6L6HSDktS7F2HyNA%2B1HfYBwJwIqxTCp91vgIll%0AXQvuSDPeInt%2FZ6Hs5g%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792921121/404cb8368b3daed0c0722b9a/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174002.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=7cd7b652aad2c8126142e8f68e1a0bdea1521d321bec70f7f208b39ca007fed9&amp;req=cyklH8t%2FnINeFb4f3HP0gC6L6HSDktS7F2HyNA%2B1HfYBwJwIqxTCp91vgIll%0AXQvuSDPeInt%2FZ6Hs5g%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="504" height="461"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A Favourite thread will have a ⭐ icon on the right of its thread item. This icon will also appear in the Chat header after the contact name.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792924263/b333b5013dbcb5336fd21708/Screenshot+2023-07-25+at+18-10-31+Backoffice+-+bsport.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6aac379ae4c3237c04a089adf4d3f0acd43863772bb4f5f79d95c6fe8161f590&amp;req=cyklH8t6n4dcFb4f3HP0gH941BY9n3CT5WuCKG84ig8yHOs69wmHirMaFoMZ%0AQJpOIw4sGqZIl8QlSg%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792924263/b333b5013dbcb5336fd21708/Screenshot+2023-07-25+at+18-10-31+Backoffice+-+bsport.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6aac379ae4c3237c04a089adf4d3f0acd43863772bb4f5f79d95c6fe8161f590&amp;req=cyklH8t6n4dcFb4f3HP0gH941BY9n3CT5WuCKG84ig8yHOs69wmHirMaFoMZ%0AQJpOIw4sGqZIl8QlSg%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="410" height="391"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A favourite thread will always appear at the top of the list. If there are several favourites to display, first the favourites are sorted by time since the last message, and then the non-favourites are displayed, sorted by time as well.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can filter the threads to only display Favourite threads, <a href="#h_177be38ea1">see below</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can remove the thread from your favourites by clicking on the &quot;...&quot; button on the thread item and selecting the &quot;Remove as favourite&quot; option.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_8e14e3d4a7">Mute a thread</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792921299/81d7109490be60dff89d2c81/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174014.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=7d5c26a3e8499a6ad30f21eaef8b83934e04368d4173f0cf58c653ae3424b084&amp;req=cyklH8t%2Fn4hWFb4f3HP0gO6z%2Ft2CKKaODLYikLU7mqgvSIfpLaLrSKLUhSK4%0AvNGEOEd9CXe9eeiO5A%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792921299/81d7109490be60dff89d2c81/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174014.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=7d5c26a3e8499a6ad30f21eaef8b83934e04368d4173f0cf58c653ae3424b084&amp;req=cyklH8t%2Fn4hWFb4f3HP0gO6z%2Ft2CKKaODLYikLU7mqgvSIfpLaLrSKLUhSK4%0AvNGEOEd9CXe9eeiO5A%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="504" height="466"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A Muted thread will have a 🔕 icon displayed on its thread icon and in the Chat header after the contact name.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When new messages are received in a muted thread, the number of unread messages on the thread item will be displayed in a grey circle rather than a red one. More importantly, newly received messages will not update the date of the last message for this thread, therefore it will not be pushed to the top of the list. Muted threads will gradually be moved to the end of the list of threads as other active threads will move to the top. However, if you read or send messages on a muted thread, the date of the last message will update.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can filter the threads to only display Muted threads, <a href="#h_177be38ea1">see below</a>.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>You can unmute the thread by clicking on the &quot;...&quot; button on the thread item and selecting the &quot;Unmute&quot; option.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading3 intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h3 id="h_49d88856aa">Archive a thread</h3></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-center"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792907503/fb5dc09f2f1065f714161c08/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174025.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6f0c414d32cb38074292b0819c8ad9a89e5e09b9915011bc59ba82e79133f4bb&amp;req=cyklH8l5mIFcFb4f3HP0gAypklowqOVhjZ2VC7BjHciSOZzAQ2ZpPDhRq9rF%0Ac7YbWH%2FJ5JH2qPpijg%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792907503/fb5dc09f2f1065f714161c08/Capture+d-%C3%A9cran+2023-07-25+174025.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=6f0c414d32cb38074292b0819c8ad9a89e5e09b9915011bc59ba82e79133f4bb&amp;req=cyklH8l5mIFcFb4f3HP0gAypklowqOVhjZ2VC7BjHciSOZzAQ2ZpPDhRq9rF%0Ac7YbWH%2FJ5JH2qPpijg%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="504" height="463"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>An Archived thread will disappear from the Thread tab, even when searching for it with the search tab.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>However, the chat messages are not deleted. <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If your member base comes from a migration from your previous provider, you may have many inactive members. It is also possible that some of your members have not been coming to your studio for a long time.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To avoid that these inactive members come to overload your customer database you can archive them.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><b>Step 1: Archive a member</b></p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to the member tab, on the line of a member click on the trash can icon.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>It happens that you end up with duplicate customer records. This can happen when one and the same member registers twice with 2 different email addresses.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>To merge two member accounts: </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Go to the<b> member account who must be deleted </b>&gt; Click on &quot;<b>Merge</b>&quot;. </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/715926389/441818a7d90be5307aea0485/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=ccc795e284b684bfa16df825d3aac6384bcabbe05a18e55fe33272ae6082a8da&amp;req=cyEiH8t4nolWFb4f3HP0gEZ8G7Mxvfz1ORfK6w1fxpvUjgpeI%2FO6tNw9FOGg%0AkpzbOe41dks8FZMpZA%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/715926389/441818a7d90be5307aea0485/image.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=ccc795e284b684bfa16df825d3aac6384bcabbe05a18e55fe33272ae6082a8da&amp;req=cyEiH8t4nolWFb4f3HP0gEZ8G7Mxvfz1ORfK6w1fxpvUjgpeI%2FO6tNw9FOGg%0AkpzbOe41dks8FZMpZA%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="618" height="576"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Find the member <b>whose account should be kept</b> &gt; <div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Two options are available to filter the data in your reports:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Quick filters: as the name suggests, this method is faster and requires fewer user inputs.</p></div></li><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Filtered views: this system is useful to easily switch between different filters, and offers more precise filtering thanks to and/or rules management.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Note that it is possible to apply both quick filters and a filtered view to the report. In this case, the items of the report would have to match both sets of filters.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-heading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h1 id="h_808b6a9a90">Option 1: Using quick filters</h1></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p><i>Reporting</i> &gt; Select a report &gt; <i>Add a filter</i> &gt; Select which column you want to filter on.</p></div></li></ul></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-image intercom-interblocks-align-left"><a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/856961760/1b9e7aa12da51f9927985319/Quick+filter.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=f0d49a55f353bac8ed8516193dab3ecaa035be280198ecfba7054ff4ce15a1f4&amp;req=fCUhH89%2FmodfFb4f3HP0gJIkZVB9D7RdCrlgZZDXQxq2cpk6xvd5F72BdPym%0A9sXvR6CkDDOBIrib9Q%3D%3D%0A" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer nofollow noopener"><img src="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/856961760/1b9e7aa12da51f9927985319/Quick+filter.png?expires=1778852700&amp;signature=f0d49a55f353bac8ed8516193dab3ecaa035be280198ecfba7054ff4ce15a1f4&amp;req=fCUhH89%2FmodfFb4f3HP0gJIkZVB9D7RdCrlgZZDXQxq2cpk6xvd5F72BdPym%0A9sXvR6CkDDOBIrib9Q%3D%3D%0A" alt="" width="1920" height="995"/></a></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-unordered-nested-list"><ul><li><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Configure the quick filter. ### Intercom
**URL:** https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/8320705-accrual-vs-cash-accounting

<div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Cash and accrual accounting are two widely recognized approaches to managing your company&#x27;s financial records. Understanding the distinction between these methods is crucial because they handle gift cards and internal account balances in contrasting ways. In this article, we&#x27;ll explain the differences between these two methodologies and clarify why we opt for accrual-based accounting for our <b><i>Purchases</i></b> report.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>Consider this scenario:</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>On August 1st, a customer purchases a £100 gift card from your business. Subsequently, on August 18th, the customer&#x27;s friend uses the gift card to purchase a £100 pass. At what point did your business generate revenue? The answer will be different depending on the method of accounting utilized.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_c23c9c4025"><b>Cash-based accounting</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In cash-based accounting, revenue is recognized on the day your business receives payment through methods like cash, check, or credit. This means that when a purchase is made with a gift card or the internal account balance, there is no transaction to log because no actual cash has been received.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>A cash-based financial report will reflect the revenue earned when a customer initially buys the gift card, but will not display the products or services subsequently acquired using that gift card.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In our example scenario, the £100 sale is recognized as revenue when the client purchases the gift card on August 1st, and no transaction is reported when the client&#x27;s friend uses the gift card on August 18th.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_309a046741"><b>Accrual-based accounting</b></h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In accrual-based accounting, revenue is recognized on the day a sale is made, regardless of when the payment is received. This means that when a purchase is made with a gift card or the internal account balance, the business will recognize revenue on that day and not on the day the balance was credited, or the gift card was purchased.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>An accrual-based financial report will not display the initial purchase of a gift card, but will reflect the revenue earned when a customer subsequently acquires products using that gift card.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>In our example scenario, the £100 sale is recognized as revenue when the client&#x27;s friend uses the gift card on August 18th, and no transaction is reported when the client purchases the gift card on August 1st.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-subheading intercom-interblocks-align-left"><h2 id="h_1a238bf421">Why our Purchases report uses accrual-based accounting</h2></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>When a business sells gift cards or offers account credit, accrual-based accounting is the recommended method. Since our platform provides both gift cards and an internal account balance, we use accrual-based accounting. Our <b><i>Purchases</i></b> report will not show the purchases of gift cards or the crediting of an internal account balance.</p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p> </p></div><div class="intercom-interblocks-paragraph no-margin intercom-interblocks-align-left"><p>If you need to specifically track the purchases of gift cards, our report <b><i>Purchased gift cards</i></b> can provide you with the necessary information.</p></div><section class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 related_articles my-6"><hr class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 my-6 sm:my-8"/><div class="jsx-62724fba150252e0 mb-3 text-xl font-bold">Related Articles</div><section class="flex flex-col rounded-card border border-solid border-card-border bg-card-bg p-2 sm:p-3"><a class="duration-250 group/article flex flex-row justify-between gap-2 py-2 no-underline transition ease-linear hover:bg-primary-alpha-10 hover:text-primary sm:rounded-card-inner sm:py-3 rounded-card-inner px-3" href="https://intercom.help/bsport-helpcenter/en/articles/9234356-how-to-add-an-account-number-to-your-products" data-testid="article-link"><div class="flex flex-col p-0"><span class="m-0 text-md text-body-primary-color group-hover/article:text-primary">How to add an account number to your products?</span></div><div class="flex shrink-0 flex-col justify-center p-0"><svg class="block h-4 w-4 text-primary ltr:-rotate-90 rtl:rotate-90" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M5.293 7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 10.586l3.293-3.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></a></section></section>
